raw.title: XTN-28A4286 | BILLING & COLLECTIONS MANAGER
raw.excerpt: We are seeking a Billing & Collections Manager to own and lead the billing and collections function for our growing litigation practice, including the monthly billing cycle, collections, retainers, and the processes and reporting behind them.
raw.description:
We are seeking a Billing & Collections Manager to own and lead the billing and collections function for our growing litigation practice, including the monthly billing cycle, collections, retainers, and the processes and reporting behind them. Our clients are often navigating one of the most stressful financial periods of their lives, and how we bill and collect is part of how we care for them. This role calls for someone who combines rigorous billing management with genuine empathy, a person who keeps receivables healthy through relationships, clear communication, and follow-through rather than pressure.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the firm's end-to-end monthly billing cycle, from pre-bill preparation and review through invoice delivery.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for client billing inquiries, payment arrangements, and account follow-up.
  • Manage accounts receivable and lead collections through respectful, empathetic client conversations.
  • Oversee retainer replenishments and trust-to-general transfers in coordination with the firm's lawyers and clerks.
  • Design, improve, and document the firm's billing processes as the practice grows.
  • Maintain confidentiality while handling sensitive client and financial information in compliance with all ethical and professional standards.
  • 100% remote work arrangement.
  • Flexible work schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • Collaborative, supportive, and people-first work environment.
  • Work alongside exceptional leaders who value mentorship, autonomy, and professional growth.
  • Direct exposure to and collaboration with executives, lawyers, and business leaders.
  • Opportunity to own and shape the firm's billing and collections function as the organization grows.
  • Continuous learning and development in a highly specialized tax litigation practice.
  • Be part of a close-knit team where your contributions have a direct impact on the firm's success.

Key Responsibilities

1. Billing Operations & Monthly Cycle

  • Own the monthly billing calendar; prepare, review, and finalize pre-bills in coordination with lawyers and law clerks.
  • Review draft bills for accuracy, consistency, and correct allocation of time across related matters before release.
  • Generate and deliver accurate, clearly presented invoices on a consistent monthly schedule.
  • Track unbilled work-in-progress and follow up internally to ensure time is recorded and billed promptly.

2. Collections & Accounts Receivable Management

  • Monitor accounts receivable and conduct timely, structured follow-up on outstanding invoices.
  • Approach every collections conversation with patience, empathy, and professionalism, recognizing that many clients are under significant financial and emotional stress.
  • Work with clients to establish realistic payment arrangements and see them through to completion.
  • Know when to listen, when to problem-solve, and when to escalate an account to a lawyer.

3. Retainers & Trust Coordination

  • Monitor retainer balances and coordinate replenishment requests before balances are exhausted.
  • Support trust-to-general transfers and account reconciliations in coordination with the firm's bookkeeping function and in accordance with Law Society of Ontario trust accounting requirements.

4. Reporting, Process Ownership & Improvement

  • Maintain accurate billing and receivables records in the firm's practice management systems.
  • Prepare monthly reporting for firm leadership on billings, collections, realization, aged receivables, and unbilled time.
  • Administer the firm's billing review and approval processes, including discount and write-down approvals.
  • Identify and implement improvements to billing workflows, templates, and client payment options as the firm grows.
  • Train and support timekeepers on billing practices, and help onboard and guide future billing staff as the team expands.

5. Compliance & Confidentiality

  • Adhere to professional guidelines and legal requirements regarding confidentiality and client financial information.
  • Ensure billing records are maintained, stored, and disposed of in accordance with legal and professional standards.

Qualifications

Experience

  • A minimum of 2 years of experience managing billing and collections at a law firm is required, including hands-on responsibility for issuing monthly invoices and collecting fees directly from clients.
  • Experience supervising billing staff or owning a firm's billing function end-to-end is an asset.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency with legal billing or practice management software and the Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Experience working with Clio is a significant asset.
  • Familiarity with trust accounting requirements in a law firm setting is an asset.
  • Strong numeracy and accuracy in reconciling accounts.

Soft Skills

  • Exceptional empathy and emotional intelligence with the ability to have difficult money conversations while preserving client dignity and strengthening relationships.
  • A relationship-based, soft-skills approach to collections. This is not a pressure-tactics role.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills, discretion, and reliable follow-through.
  • Calm, patient, and composed under pressure.

  • Experience scaling engineering organizations and building high-performing technical teams.

Overview

Lynker Corporation is seeking a Sea Ice Model Evaluation and Applications Scientist to support the Ocean and Tsunami Center (OTC) and the U.S. National Ice Center (USNIC), to support operational and research activities involving numerical sea ice forecast guidance. The Sea Ice Model Evaluation and Applications Scientist will evaluate guidance from systems such as the Global Forecast System (GFS), Global Ensemble Forecasting System (GEFS), Seasonal Forecast System (SFS), Real-Time Ocean Forecast System (RTOFS), and Navy forecast systems, with primary emphasis on improving the operational use of Arctic sea ice guidance for forecast Days 8–14 and exploratory application at other lead times.

Responsibilities

Duties of the Sea Ice Model Evaluation and Applications Scientist will include the following:

  • The Sea Ice Model Evaluation and Applications Scientist will perform the job duties independently and collaboratively, exercising initiative and applying innovative methods to evaluate and increase the operational use of numerical sea ice guidance.
  • The candidate will work with USNIC forecasters, NWS OTC scientists, model developers, and external collaborators to assess model performance, assess how IMS products could better support model initialization and evaluation, and demonstrate prototype extended-range sea ice guidance for the USNIC.
  • The candidate will also provide recommendations regarding the scientific and operational readiness of evaluated guidance for potential transition to operations.

Qualifications

The Sea Ice Model Evaluation and Applications Scientist selected should have the following:

  • Knowledge of numerical weather, ocean, sea ice, or coupled Earth-system modeling.
  • Experience in model testing, evaluation, or forecast verification.
  • Proficiency in Python for scientific data analysis.
  • Experience working with gridded environmental datasets and formats such as NetCDF or GRIB.
  • Experience working in a UNIX or Linux environment.
  • Ability to communicate technical findings to scientists, software developers, and operational analysts and forecasters.
  • The qualified candidate shall have a degree (e.g., BS, but advanced degree is preferred, e.g., MS or Ph.D.) from an accredited institution in Atmospheric Science, Oceanography, or other Geophysical Sciences, Engineering, Computer Sciences, or Mathematics and have at least 2 years of career experience in related areas.

The Ideal Sea Ice Model Evaluation and Applications Scientist will have the following:

  • Knowledge of sea ice analysis, forecasting, remote sensing, dynamics, or thermodynamics.
  • Experience with ensemble prediction or medium-range and subseasonal forecast evaluation.
  • Experience in workflow development, research-to-operations activities, or operational product development.
  • Experience using ArcGIS Pro, ArcPy, or developing geospatial tools and workflows within an Esri environment.

About Lynker

Lynker is a growing, employee owned business, specializing in professional, scientific and technical services. Our continually expanding team combines scientific expertise with mature, results-driven processes and tools to achieve technically sound, cost effective solutions in hydrology/water sciences, geospatial analysis, information technology, resource management, conservation, and management and business process improvement.

We focus on putting the right people in the right place to be effective. And having the right people is critical for success. Our streamlined organization enables and empowers our talented professionals to tackle our customers' scientific and technical priorities – creatively and effectively.

Lynker offers a team-oriented work environment, and the opportunity to work in a culture of exceptionally skilled professionals who embrace sound science and creative solutions. Lynker's benefits include the following:

Since 2015, we’ve completed many of the world’s first digital commerce transactions, including the first online real estate closing, online mortgage closing, online auto sale, and online will and we're still just getting started!

We are seeking an experienced Strategic Enterprise Account Manager to join our Sales team and take ownership of a high-value book of business. This is a farmer role focused on managing and expanding relationships within our most strategic enterprise accounts. The ideal candidate is supremely organized, highly responsive, and passionate about delivering long-term value to customers through thoughtful account management and growth strategies.

  • Maintain accurate forecasts and reporting in Salesforce and other GTM systems

As our Strategic Enterprise Account Manager, you should have:

  • 10+ years of enterprise account management or strategic customer success experience
  • A strong track record of growing large strategic accounts and demonstrated success expanding multi-million-dollar relationships
  • Industry experience in real estate (title/lender), financial services, or insurance highly preferred
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple accounts and deadlines

  • Strong analytical skills with an attention to detail.
  • Executive presence.

  • Own It: We embrace the responsibility that comes with supporting life's most important transactions. When a problem arises we relentlessly pursue the solution with a 'Yes before no' attitude. Because every problem and every transaction is treated like it's our own.

If we make a mistake, we own up to it right away and do what it takes to make it right. Our dedication to security and compliance is key to earning trust, fighting fraud and ultimately, our success.

About the Role

We're looking for a highly organized and proactive Executive Assistant to support both of our Co-Founders with day-to-day inbox management, scheduling, travel coordination, and administrative tasks. This is a high-trust role that requires strong judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate professionally on behalf of senior leadership.

Work Structure & Requirements

  • Location: Remote / Virtual
  • Schedule: Part-time to start, with potential to grow
  • Time Zone: Must be available during EST/Toronto business hours
  • Compensation: $7 USD per hour

Key Responsibilities

1. Inbox Management

  • Triage and flag urgent vs. FYI emails for both Co-Founders
  • Draft and send routine replies — meeting confirms, thank-yous, scheduling back-and-forth
  • Manage a "needs Founder voice" folder for anything investor, talent, or partner-facing
  • Unsubscribe and clean up noise; manage newsletters
  • Track follow-ups that haven't received a response

2. Scheduling & Calendar Management

  • Manage calendars across time zones and coordinate meetings
  • Protect buffer time and no-meeting blocks
  • Send agendas and reminders ahead of key calls
  • Reschedule or decline on the Founders' behalf per their rules of engagement

3. Travel Booking

  • Book flights, hotels, and ground transport for conferences, investor trips, and retail meetings
  • Build and share trip itineraries (single doc/PDF per trip)
  • Track points and loyalty programs
  • Handle changes and cancellations; collect expense receipts tied to each trip

4. Data Entry & Admin

  • Update CRM records and maintain trackers (AP aging, vendor payment plans, cap table notes) — inputting only, not judgment calls
  • Document filing and folder organization (Drive hygiene)
  • Distribute meeting notes and action items

Required Skills & Experience

  • Experience: Prior experience as an Executive Assistant, VA, or senior admin supporting founder-level or executive leadership
  • Communication: Exceptional written English — able to draft professional replies that represent the Founders accurately
  • Organization: Strong calendar and inbox management instincts; comfortable managing competing priorities across two executives
  • Tools: Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Calendar); CRM familiarity a plus
  • Profile: Discreet, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently with minimal daily oversight

The Sr. Cloud Database Administrator (Snowflake Platform) will design, implement, secure, optimize, and maintain the enterprise Snowflake platform within AWS cloud environments. This role is responsible for platform administration, security, governance, performance optimization, automation, and operational excellence while partnering with Data Engineering, Analytics, DevOps, and Security teams to deliver a scalable and secure cloud data platform.

What you will do

  • Administer and maintain the Snowflake platform, including databases, schemas, warehouses, roles, users, resource monitors, and data-sharing capabilities.
  • Design and implement scalable Snowflake architectures to support enterprise analytics, data engineering, and AI/ML workloads.
  • Develop and maintain Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), row-level security, masking policies, network policies, and data governance standards.
  • Optimize warehouse sizing, query performance, clustering strategies, storage utilization, and overall platform cost efficiency.
  • Design and implement secure data sharing, external stages, storage integrations, Snowpipe, Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables, and other native Snowflake capabilities.
  • Develop backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity strategies using Snowflake Time Travel, Fail-safe, replication, and cross-region replication features.
  • Automate Snowflake deployments using Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD pipelines with tools such as Terraform, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar technologies.
  • Develop and maintain version-controlled SQL objects, including databases, schemas, tables, views, stored procedures, tasks, streams, sequences, and security objects.
  • Monitor platform health, resource consumption, query performance, and security events using Snowflake monitoring capabilities and enterprise observability tools.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering teams to support dbt, Airflow, ELT pipelines, and enterprise data integration initiatives.
  • Develop Python and SQL automation to simplify administrative tasks, platform provisioning, monitoring, and operational processes.
  • Partner with Security, Architecture, and Governance teams to implement platform standards, compliance requirements, and operational best practices.
  • Mentor database administrators and data engineers on Snowflake administration, platform standards, and operational excellence.
  • Stay current with Snowflake features, cloud technologies, and industry best practices, recommending opportunities for platform improvements.
  • Document platform architecture, administration procedures, standards, and operational runbooks.

What you will bring

  • Minimum of 8 years of database administration experience, including 3+ years administering enterprise Snowflake environments.
  • Strong knowledge of Snowflake architecture, virtual warehouses, storage, compute optimization, and platform administration.
  • Hands-on experience implementing Snowflake security, including RBAC, masking policies, row access policies, network policies, and secure data sharing.
  • Experience designing and optimizing Snowflake performance, workload management, and cost optimization strategies.
  • Experience with Snowflake native capabilities, including Tasks, Streams, Dynamic Tables, Snowpipe, External Tables, Secure Views, and Stored Procedures.
  • Experience managing Snowflake across AWS cloud environments.
  • Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, and modern cloud data platforms.
  • Experience using Git-based source control and CI/CD pipelines for Snowflake object deployments.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or similar automation tools.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with Python or Shell scripting for platform automation.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with cross-functional technical teams.

What will set you apart

  • SnowPro Core Certification or SnowPro Advanced Certifications.
  • Experience with dbt, Apache Airflow, Terraform, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar DevOps platforms.
  • Experience implementing enterprise data governance and security frameworks.
  • Experience administering cloud data platforms within AWS.
  • Experience supporting enterprise analytics, AI/ML, and modern data platform initiatives.

This job operates in a professional office environment.

  • Retirement savings – 401(k) plan with generous company matching contributions (up to 6%), financial advisory services, potential company discretionary contribution, and a broad investment lineup

Work directly with the customer and business owners to identify new ideas and collaborate across verticals, regions, and functional areas to evaluate, pilot, develop and implement warehouse automation solutions.

raw.description:
**This position can be fully remote or hybrid near Mitacs offices in Montreal, Toronto or Vancouver**

Do you want to be part of a mission driven organization shaping Canada’s innovation future? Do you thrive in collaborative environments where creativity, continuous improvement, and strategic thinking are valued? Are you motivated by work that strengthens Canada’s competitiveness and delivers meaningful impact for communities and businesses?

At Mitacs, we take a talent first approach to building Canada’s innovation capacity. We connect researchers with organizations across every region of the country to help solve pressing challenges and accelerate economic growth. By enabling business academic collaboration and supporting the development of highly skilled talent, we contribute to a resilient, future ready Canadian economy.

Guided by our values — Impact, Integrity, Collaboration, Excellence, and Talent — we work with partners nationwide to advance research, commercialization, and innovation.

At Mitacs, you become part of a team committed to empowering Canadian talent, fostering meaningful partnerships, and driving innovation that supports Canada’s long-term competitiveness. If you’re inspired by big ideas and passionate about creating national impact, we encourage you to apply.

Position Summary

This full-time temporary role (contract until March 31, 2027) supports the effective delivery of HR services across Mitacs by coordinating recruitment, employee lifecycle administration, HR operations, reporting, learning and development logistics, and employee experience initiatives. Working closely with members of the HR team, hiring managers, and employees, the role helps ensure HR processes are accurate, timely, consistent, and aligned with Mitacs’ values and commitment to service excellence.

This position is well suited to someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, collaborative, and motivated by supporting people-focused programs and practical improvements that strengthen the employee experience at Mitacs.

Responsibilities

Recruitment & Hiring Support

  • Coordinate recruitment activities, including job postings, candidate screening, interview scheduling, reference checks, and new hire documentation.
  • Support hiring managers with recruitment process information, tools, templates, and candidate communications.
  • Coordinate onboarding and offboarding activities, including HRIS updates, payroll and benefits coordination, onboarding schedules, and exit interview scheduling.

HR Operations and Reporting

  • Maintain accurate employee records and support HRIS, payroll, benefits, and employee lifecycle administration.
  • Coordinate logistics, materials, tracking, and follow-up for training, learning and development sessions, employee presentations, and HR-led initiatives.
  • Track, compile, and report HR metrics and program information to support recruitment, workforce planning, learning and development, and employee experience priorities.
  • Support routine employee leaves, benefits changes, accommodation coordination, and related employee lifecycle activities, escalating complex matters as appropriate.
  • Support maintenance of HR policies, procedures, templates, and employee-facing resources to ensure information is current and accessible.

HR Programs and Employee Experience

  • Respond to routine employee inquiries through the EmployeeCare inbox and direct employees and managers to appropriate HR resources or team members.
  • Provide coordination support for performance management, engagement, culture, and other HR projects and initiatives.
  • Support employee internal communications and presentations related to HR programs, learning and development, and employee experience.
  • Support HR programs and initiatives aligned with the HR Plan, including learning and development, employee experience, internal mobility, recognition, and One Mitacs culture.
  • Identify opportunities to improve HR coordination processes, tools, templates, and employee-facing resources.
  • Perform other related duties as required.

Experience and skills

  • Bilingualism in English and French. Knowledge of written and spoken English and French is required in this role as you will interact with colleagues, clients, and stakeholders located across Canada.
  • Post-secondary education in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 1-3 years of experience in HR coordination, administration, recruitment support or other HR functions.
  • Demonstrated experience and ability to build effective working relationships across teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and discretion.
  • Strong attention to detail with ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Working understanding of employment standards, HR policies, and HR best practices.
  • Mitacs is committed to reconciliation with Indigenous communities across Canada. Lived experience or perspectives connected to Indigenous worldviews are considered strong assets.  

Equity, diversity, and inclusion and reconciliation are strong commitments at Mitacs: Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion - Mitacs. We believe a diverse workforce comprised of individuals with different lived experiences, ideas, strengths, and backgrounds (e.g., gender identities and expressions, Indigeneity, race, abilities, sexual orientation, and other identities) are crucial to our success. We welcome everyone to apply and encourage you to connect with us if you require accommodations during the recruitment process.

Hiring Range: $46,875 - $59,375

Hiring and Salary Range Transparency 

Typically, employees are hired, transferred, or promoted within the salary range, specifically between the minimum and midpoint in the hiring range.

The salary range refers to the range of base salaries for a given position, encompassing the minimum and maximum amounts. The midpoint of the range is positioned approximately halfway between the minimum and maximum, indicating a fully qualified employee with comprehensive job knowledge and experience for the role.

Only in rare and exceptional circumstances, where a candidate has the experience, skills, and expertise that far exceed those required for the position, would we consider paying above the hiring range for this role.

Our recruitment process may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools to support activities. Any use of AI is subject to human review and all hiring decisions are made by a human member of our hiring team.

raw.description:
About OpenSesame

OpenSesame is the trusted partner for Workforce Reinvention in the age of AI. OpenSesame delivers integrated software, curated and customizable content, and expert services – embedded into existing learning, HR, and work systems – to help organizations expand their human+AI potential and thrive through change.

Learn more:

About the team

The OpenSesame Sales Development team is the outbound growth engine of the company — fueling conversations that help organizations transform learning and development. We collaborate, experiment, and constantly learn from each other in a high-performance, team-oriented environment that blends data, curiosity, and authenticity.

What makes our Sales Development team unique:

  • We invest deeply in both professional and personal growth.
  • We are lifelong learners, passionate about making work and learning easier for our customers.
  • We measure success by the success of our prospects and customers.
  • We operate with the mindset of owners — grounded in honesty, integrity, and accountability.
  • We do the right thing, even when it’s the hard thing.
  • We communicate the value of OpenSesame with clarity and empathy — always with the customer’s success at the center.
  • We believe in the power of teamwork — supporting each other through peer coaching, shared insights, and collaborative problem-solving so the entire team gets better together.

About the Role

We’re seeking a driven, curious, and tech-savvy Sales Development Representative to join our growing team. This role is ideal for someone looking to build a long-term career in B2B SaaS sales while being part of a forward-thinking team that uses AI and automation to work smarter, not harder.

As an SDR, you’ll partner closely with Account Executives to design and execute strategic outbound prospecting campaigns that create meaningful, qualified conversations with HR, Learning, and Talent leaders across the globe. You’ll learn how to balance automation with authenticity — using cutting-edge tools like Gong Engage, Qualified, ZoomInfo Co-pilot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and ChatGPT Enterprise to drive outbound excellence.

You’ll master the art of personalized, data-informed outreach while leveraging automation to focus on what really matters: connecting with people and helping them solve real business challenges.

Performance Objectives:

Within 30 Days:

  • Complete OpenSesame’s Sales Development onboarding and training program.
  • Learn how OpenSesame goes to market and become familiar with our products, industry, and ideal customer profile (ICP).
  • Demonstrate mastery of OpenSesame’s core messaging and discovery framework through live call certification or mock calls with manager.”
  • Shadow peers and participate in Gong Engage call reviews to learn what world-class conversations sound like.
  • Collaborate with your Account Executive to build your strategic account list and understand your territory plan.

Within 60 Days:

  • Begin executing account-based outbound strategies that align with Marketing campaigns and AE priorities.
  • Use tools like Gong Engage, Qualified, ZoomInfo Co-pilot, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator to research accounts, identify key stakeholders, and personalize outreach.
  • Apply AI-assisted workflows to automate research and first-pass messaging — while maintaining genuine personalization in calls and emails.
  • Meet or exceed your ramp goals for meetings set and activities completed.

Within 90 Days:

  • Consistently meet or exceed daily and weekly activity goals for calls, personalized emails, and meaningful conversations; includes building personalized outreach flows with a multi-channel approach.
  • Maintain accurate records of all prospecting activity, contacts, and lead statuses within Salesforce.
  • Use Gong analytics to self-assess and improve call performance.
  • Collaborate closely with your AE to drive high-quality handoff, resulting in achieving benchmark conversion from meeting to SAL and measurable pipeline creation.
  • Provide valuable feedback to Marketing stakeholders on inbound lead quality and campaign messaging.

Within 120 Days:

  • Earn your OpenSesame Sales Development Certification by demonstrating mastery of messaging, product knowledge, and process.
  • Achieve full quota attainment for meetings set and influenced pipeline.
  • Build trusted relationships with Account Executives through consistent, high-quality collaboration.
  • Contribute to outbound innovation by sharing insights, testing new messaging approaches, and helping refine the SDR AI playbook.

Location: This position can be located anywhere in the U.S. All positions will require up to 15 days of travel per year for company-wide events (typically January, May, September).

Performance Driven: We’re looking for self-starters with a track record of follow-through, curiosity, and results. We don’t hire based on a checklist — we hire for potential, drive, and evidence of performance. If you’re motivated to learn, comfortable with experimentation, and excited about how technology can make sales more human, you’ll fit right in.

Compensation: On-target earnings for this role is $78,000 per year, which includes base salary and variable incentive compensation based on performance. At OpenSesame, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to employees upon hire, including ISOs, health insurance, 401(k) matching, and paid time off. We carefully consider a wide range of compensation factors, relying on market data to determine compensation and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience.

Benefits: Benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible PTO, 401(k) matching, incentive stock options, volunteer time off, Employee Resource Groups, and a generous professional development program with dedicated annual time off for learning and growth.

We use AI. For real. Every team at OpenSesame works with AI tools daily, not as a buzzword, but as practice. You'll build fluency that most companies are still talking about adopting, with hands-on training and clear guardrails to experiment responsibly. AI amplifies your creativity and judgment. It doesn't replace them. The skills you build here travel with you.

Equal Employment Opportunity: OpenSesame is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer that values and welcomes diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of various legally protected characteristics, including criminal history, and strive to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. We prioritize safety and security and may use your information accordingly, and you can contact us for assistance or accommodations during the job application process.

Pay Transparency: At OpenSesame, we prioritize pay transparency, fairness, and equity to create a positive and inclusive work environment, regularly reviewing our compensation practices to align with our values and goals. We provide competitive and fair compensation to our employees based on their skills, experience, and performance.

CPRA (California Candidates): When you submit your application, OpenSesame may collect and use your personal information in accordance with our privacy policy and the CPRA. This may include personal details and employment history, and will only be used for employment-related purposes. We may share this information with third-party service providers, but we will not sell it to third parties. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us, and for more information on your rights under the CPRA, refer to our privacy policy or the California Attorney General's website.

Client Overview

Our client is a globally established electrical manufacturing and clean energy technology company specializing in residential energy storage systems (ESS), smart electrical infrastructure, lithium battery solutions, intelligent power distribution products, and advanced energy management technologies. Backed by strong manufacturing capabilities, continuous product innovation, and an expanding international distribution network, the company continues to strengthen its presence across the European renewable energy market.

To support its international expansion strategy, the organization is growing its residential energy storage business in the Netherlands by establishing a dedicated distributor network and strengthening local market coverage. Operating within a highly entrepreneurial and performance-driven environment, the company empowers regional leaders to independently develop channel partnerships, expand market presence, and drive sustainable commercial growth.

Job Role

The Country Manager – Netherlands will be responsible for leading the company's residential energy storage business across the Dutch market. This role focuses on building and managing distributor channels, developing strategic customer relationships, and driving long-term business growth for residential ESS products.

Acting as the commercial lead for the Netherlands, the successful candidate will oversee the complete distributor development process, including market mapping, customer acquisition, business negotiations, contract execution, order management, and ongoing channel development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and manage a structured distributor pipeline by identifying, qualifying, and prioritizing potential channel partners across the Dutch market.
  • Identify key decision-makers, conduct customer visits, and present the company's products and value proposition while understanding customer requirements.
  • Lead commercial negotiations, contract execution, sample coordination, and follow-up activities to maximize customer conversion.
  • Manage the complete order lifecycle, including first orders, repeat business, delivery coordination, and ongoing distributor relationship management.
  • Establish and maintain long-term partnerships with distributors and strategic customers to support sustainable market growth.
  • Coordinate closely with headquarters regarding customer feedback, commercial opportunities, and business development progress.
  • Expand market coverage by continuously identifying new sales opportunities and strengthening the company's distributor ecosystem.
  • Achieve business growth objectives while ensuring effective daily channel management across the Dutch market.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree or above.
  • Chinese candidates with permanent residency in the Netherlands are preferred. Foreign candidates must be able to communicate effectively in Mandarin.
  • Strong understanding of residential energy storage products and related technologies.
  • Proven experience in B2B sales, distributor development, or channel management within the residential energy storage or renewable energy industry.
  • Excellent business negotiation, communication, and relationship management skills.
  • Strong commercial mindset with the ability to understand business logic and independently manage regional market development.
  • Preferred candidates possess approximately 5–15 years of professional working experience after university graduation.
  • Fluent in Dutch for business communication. Mandarin proficiency is required for communication and coordination with headquarters.

SUMMARY

The Client Relations Specialists (CRS) ensure customer satisfaction for our larger multi-location accounts that have multiple loss control and claims contacts. The role is for the TCC department. The Client Relations Specialists act as a liaison between AF Group, the agent and the account, and work with the agent as a vital partner to be more responsive to customer needs. This role is responsible for being a central point of contact for accounts, leading and participating in proactive customer outreach efforts to monitor customer satisfaction and ensure retention of our accounts. The Client Relations Specialists will collaborate with all internal resources assigned to and engaged with accounts. These individuals will be proficient with Riskview and assist agents, customers, and employees with complex reports and information, provide Riskview training to select agents, customers and employees via telephone, WebEx or other software solutions.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  1. This role involves maintaining ownership of assigned accounts with communication, problem-solving and Riskview support and reports.
  2. Act as the main contact / Riskview support person for large multi-location accounts and agents.
  3. Maintain contact with assigned accounts to ensure strong client relationships that result in soaring levels of satisfaction, loyalty, retention, and adoption of AF Group services.
  4. Coordinates and conducts training on use of internal AF Group website and AF Group Risk Management Information System (RMIS) via Webinar, Lync, or other software, and in person where needed.
  5. Coordinates and facilitates mid-term meetings and create documents; help ensure internal alignment.
  6. Coordinates claim review meetings and create documents.
  7. Responsible for driving customer satisfaction and retention through strong, proactive issue resolution, anticipation of future customer needs and open communication channels with customers and AF Group service teams.
  8. Consistently communicates with account service teams and agents when needed.
  9. Contacts customers at predetermined and agreed upon frequency to conduct a ‘pulse check’ on the customers to assess their current level of satisfaction, to learn about their business, and to uncover any potential opportunities for either improving current tools/services or identify opportunities.
  10. Responsible for training and oversight of large client needs and use of AF Group RMIS via Lync, Webex, or other such software, and in person where needed.
  11. Acts as back up to Client Relations team for receiving and handling incoming calls, handling priority matters, and referring to management as necessary.
  12. Provides support related to RMIS application which includes account and licensing reconciliation.
  13. Provides RMIS support, training, and report development for both internal and external customers.
  14. Composes, types, and edits correspondence in response to incoming mail, calls and other situations as necessary.

  15. Develops and maintains filing systems, informational databases and repository and generates reports as requested.

Additional Senior Client Relations Specialist Responsibilities:

  1. Facilitates claim review meetings and mid-term meetings.
  2. May visit customers at predetermined and agreed upon frequency to conduct a ‘pulse check’ on customers.
  3. Assists Corporate Marketing in identifying the need for marketing materials to be used for key clients and distribution partners.
  4. Participates in prospecting new business and supports agency expansion.
  5. Handles and leads more complex meetings, presentations, and training with clients.
  6. Assist with establishing a strategic account plan and expectations with the client.

  7. Assist with managing the overall customer lifecycle by acting as a key contact for accounts, ensuring strong client relationships that result in soaring levels of satisfaction, loyalty, retention and adoption of AF Group services.

    EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

    Relevant combination of education and experience may be considered in lieu of degree.

Client Relations Specialist:

  1. Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Marketing, Management, Insurance, or related field required.
  2. Three (3) years of business (with responsibility for or interaction with the business’ insurers), insurance or related filed experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
  3. Three (3) years customer service experience or equivalent required. Prior experience in an insurance office setting preferred.
  4. Continuous learning, as defined by the Company’s learning philosophy, is required.
  5. Previous knowledge of and experience with insurance agencies, the insurance industry or the organization, company and departmental policy and procedures preferred.
  6. Certification or progress toward certification is highly preferred and encouraged.

Senior Client Relations Specialist:

  1. Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Marketing, Management, Insurance, or related field required.
  2. Five (5) years of business (with responsibility for, or interaction with, the business’ insurers), insurance or related filed experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
  3. Five (5) years of customer service experience or equivalent required. Prior experience in an insurance office setting preferred.
  4. Continuous learning, as defined by the Company’s learning philosophy, is required.
  5. Previous knowledge of and experience with insurance agencies, the insurance industry or the organization, company and departmental policy and procedures preferred.

  6. Certification or progress toward certification is highly preferred and encouraged.

    To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  1. Excellent oral and written communication skills, including report writing skills are essential.
  2. Excellent customer service skills required.
  3. Knowledge of Professional Communications including phone skills, punctuation, spelling and grammar.
  4. Excellent analytical skills to identify improvement needs and develop solutions.
  5. Sound critical thinking and judgement skills
  6. Proficient in MS office (Word, Excel, Outlook) – advanced skills preferred.
  7. Excellent organizational skills.
  8. Confident and persuasive with strong oral/written communication, interpersonal and customer service skills are essential.
  9. Project management, organization, attention to detail and multi-tasking skills required.
  10. Ability to complete work within specified timeframes.
  11. Ability to work effectively independently and with very little direction.
  12. Individual must demonstrate integrity, good judgment, and be adaptable to changing circumstances.
  13. Ability to maintain confidentiality of highly sensitive company information.
  14. Ability to manage client relationships, especially sensitive issues and effectively problem solve.
  15. Ability to interact with all levels of staff and management, and effectively exchange information clearly and concisely, articulate, and present ideas, report facts and other information, and respond to questions as appropriate.
  16. Ability to effectively manage and facilitate multi-functional employee teams that are not direct reports.
  17. Passion for innovation; comfort with ambiguity, and desire to learn quickly in a dynamic environment.
  18. Ability to identify client needs by using effective listening and probing techniques.

Additional SKAs for Senior Client Relations Specialist:

  1. Knowledge of multi-department insurance processes and programs.
  2. Knowledgeable regarding changes in workers’ compensation statutes, case law and rehabilitation efforts/advancements to accurately interpret and apply relevant laws.

  4. Advanced MS office (Word, Excel, Outlook) skills.
  5. Ability to cultivate, develop and maintain mutually beneficial relationships with clients and working partners.
  6. Ability to apply principles of independent logical, analytical thinking to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
  7. Ability to continuously consider and evaluate ways to improve systems and processes as it relates to client support and retention.

  8. Ability to research and understand client’s business needs, identify trends, and understand their impact.

You don't just manage operations — you obsess over them. Every shipment is tracked, every forwarder is held accountable, and every purchase order is placed with full awareness of its financial impact.

You lead by doing — raising the execution bar of the team through hands-on involvement, system building, and continuous improvement. You actively leverage AI, not as a tool, but as a core operational layer — building systems, automations, and workflows that improve visibility, accuracy, and decision-making.

This is not a role for someone who wants to maintain what exists. It is for someone hungry to improve, optimize, and prove they can operate at a high-performance level.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities:

Own Supply Chain Execution & Pipeline Visibility

  • Maintain live pipeline visibility at all times — including China warehouse status, vessels in transit (ETD/ETA), and inventory received stateside. The pipeline never surprises the business.
  • Deliver month-end inventory snapshots and quarter-end reconciliations to finance without being asked.
  • Ensure AI systems automatically flag anomalies across the pipeline (delays, mismatches, risks).
  • Ensure 100% on-time product launches, QC pass rate >98% on first inspection, and On Time In Full (OTIF) >95% by Month 6.
  • Maintain >98% in-stock rate on top revenue SKUs, aged inventory <8% of total units, and drive inventory turns toward 5–8x annually.
  • Secure a minimum of 3 freight quotes per booking and ensure no forwarder is retained without performance data (ETD accuracy, delays, cost benchmarks).
  • Maintain and update a rolling 12-week supply plan, with AI-driven risk detection and reorder triggers before stockouts occur.

Drive Financial Discipline in Operations

  • Maintain a standing financial analysis for every active supplier — including cash flow impact, landed cost, and MOQ trade-offs — continuously updated via AI-powered tools.
  • Ensure no purchase order is committed to excess inventory without documented financial justification.
  • Track landed cost against target COGS on every order.
  • Deliver a monthly operations cost summary (freight, duty, storage, COGS trends) — compiled and formatted automatically via AI tools.
  • Ensure 100% application of Nairobi Protocol and all applicable duty exemptions.
  • Build and maintain an AI system that verifies HS codes and eligibility before every freight booking — zero exceptions.

Build SOPs & Scalable Systems

  • Conduct a full operational audit within the first 60 days, clearly identifying what is working, broken, missing, and where AI can enhance execution.
  • First 30 days are dedicated to learning, not restructuring, followed by a prioritized improvement roadmap presented to the Head of Operations.
  • Ensure all SOPs are documented, tested, live in Asana, and followed without supervision.
  • Audit every SOP for AI acceleration opportunities.
  • Build and implement at least 2 AI-powered tools within the first 6 months, and document and hand them off as repeatable team processes.
  • Ensure SOPs are reviewed quarterly and continuously optimized.

Own DTC Fulfillment & Inventory Strategy

  • Ensure all supply planning accounts for total demand across all channels (Amazon, DTC, wholesale, and emerging channels) — no decision is made without a full demand picture.
  • Maintain an AI-powered demand model that continuously updates forecasts and surfaces risks.
  • Ensure DTC and Amazon inventory pools never compete for the same units, with AI monitoring stock levels and reorder thresholds.
  • Own DTC fulfillment performance end-to-end — cost, lead time, and service level — escalating issues with proposed solutions before customer impact.

Lead and Develop the Operations Team

  • Assess all team members within the first 30 days, identifying strengths, gaps, and development needs.
  • Define clear ownership and weekly KPIs for each team member, ensuring accountability and independent execution.
  • Address performance gaps within 7 days — no prolonged underperformance.
  • Ensure no team member requires daily oversight on core responsibilities.
  • Coach the team on financial awareness and AI adoption, ensuring each team member delivers at least one AI-driven workflow improvement within the first 6 months.

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Amazon FBA operations, including shipment creation, AWD, inventory management, and compliance.
  • Proven experience managing overseas suppliers (preferably China), booking freight with multiple forwarders, and handling customs and duty optimization.
  • Strong experience managing inventory across multiple fulfillment channels, with a track record of maintaining high in-stock rates and controlling aged inventory.
  • Experience leading and managing a team (minimum 2 direct reports), with clear evidence of accountability and performance management.
  • Proven experience building, following, and improving SOPs and operational processes.
  • Hands-on experience building AI tools, automations, or workflows is strongly preferred.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to detail: does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
  • Commitment (Work ethic): possesses a strong willingness to work hard and sometimes long hours to get the job done.
  • Consistency (Persistency): demonstrates tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done.
  • Growth (Growth mindset): continuously seeks to learn, improve, and grow.
  • Problem solver (Proactivity): acts without being told what to do and brings new ideas.
  • Trust (Honesty/integrity): operates with transparency and high ethical standards.

Leadership Competencies:

  • Efficiency: builds systems that maximize output and eliminate wasted effort.
  • Analytical skills: applies financial thinking to every operational decision.
  • Organization & Planning: manages multiple complex workflows without failure.
  • Calm under pressure: maintains performance and clarity in high-stress situations.
  • High standards: operates with a zero-error mindset on execution and reporting.
  • Enthusiasm: brings energy and passion for logistics, AI, and operational excellence.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Direct ownership of critical operations and supply chain performance.
  • High impact role with significant autonomy and decision-making power.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored company trips.
  • Quarterly performance-based bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for an operations leader who thrives in high-performance environments, combines analytical thinking with execution excellence, and is driven by ownership, accountability, and continuous optimization.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About the Role
Salesforce is looking for a Pre-Sales Solution Engineer with deep Master Data Management expertise to join our SMB Solution Engineering team. In this role, you will be the technical authority on MDM within a fast-moving, high-volume SMB segment — helping customers understand how trusted, governed master data unlocks business value.

You will partner directly with Account Executives throughout the sales cycle — leading technical discovery, delivering tailored demonstrations and Proofs of Concept, and making architectural recommendations that connect MDM solutions to real business outcomes. You will also play a bridge role between MuleSoft and Informatica, helping the team and our customers think creatively about combined GTM motions.

    • Governance & Workflows: Configurable workflows, data stewardship, task management, reference data and data quality integration

    • Data Integration: Ingress/egress and real-time interaction with master data

  • Conduct technical discovery to document, analyze, and clarify business and MDM-specific requirements

  • Deliver solution demonstrations, whiteboarding sessions, architecture workshops, and Proofs of Concept that showcase MDM capabilities in the context of SMB integration challenges

  • Respond to RFI/RFP documents independently

  • Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Product Marketing to continuously improve our MDM and Data Foundation offerings

  • Stay ahead of the evolving MDM, iPaaS, and AI landscape; maintain a sharp understanding of competitive positioning

  • Strong presentation and discovery skills; comfortable in front of technical and non-technical audiences at all levels

  • Ability to establish trust with customers and influence key decision makers

  • Experience with cloud technologies — iPaaS, SaaS, cloud infrastructure

  • Experience building and delivering PoCs and responding to RFIs/RFPs independently

  • Ability to lead architectural discussions

  • Comfort operating in a high-volume, high-ambiguity SMB environment

Required Qualifications

  • B.S. Computer Science, Software Engineering, MIS

  • Knowledge of related applications, relational database and web technology

  • Solid oral, written, presentation, collaboration and interpersonal communication skills

  • Ability to work as part of a team to solve technical problems in varied political environments

raw.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

The Customer Success Consultant is a partner and customer-facing role aligned to our GPS customer segment, driving customer value and success through optimal utilization of Lumen solutions. This is accomplished by ensuring partners and customers realize and experience value from Lumen, monitoring indicators of partner customer health, addressing partner and customer concerns, and helping them better use our technology/products to meet their corporate goals and objectives. With established trust and loyalty, this role seeks to naturally progress and expand the partnership through identifying potential up-sell and cross-sell opportunities and engaging sales accordingly.

The Main Responsibilities

• Construct and implement customer success plans, driving customer value realization Manage customer metrics, including usage data, health indicators, and renewal dates in alignment with objectives
• Evaluate product and portal adoption maturity level and address roadblocks leveraging digital marketing slicks, adoption articles and other templates Build value-based relationships with customers to optimize CS plays while leveraging self-service Share thought leadership with customers based on needs resulting in strengthened customer trust
• Identify and qualify opportunities for expansion, partnering closely with sales Implement revenue management practices driving accountability and goal alignment
• Revenue retention and growth strategies including value realization, renewal execution, risk management and customer growth
• Manage risks to customers' success, identify root causes, define and activate solutions, and deploy cross-functional support to resolve
• Onboard new customers and partner with sales, delivery and support to ensure successful deployment of solutions and services including bill reviews and audits
• Define and execute renewal methodology aligned with customer priorities to positively impact profit margins

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • 5+ years customer success or account management experience
  • Education Level: Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience
  • Experience working with large and medium enterprise customers
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with ability to build strategic relationships within customer accounts
  • Ability to work closely with the customer and effectively negotiate directly with the customer and internally on their behalf
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into customer insights and leverage with customer engagement strategies
  • Experience in collaborating and guiding cross-functional teams (e.g. Sales, Product, Marketing, Service Delivery)
  • Brings technology and data networking knowledge with technical aptitude to stay current in evolving technology sector
  • Effective and confident decision making based on business and financial principles

Are you a strategic marketing leader who can turn business goals into impactful campaigns that drive engagement and revenue? Oregon Lottery is looking for one (1) Manager, Marketing to join the Go-To-Market Operations team in a remote position. This is a remote position with occasional on site travel approximately once per quarter to attend team meetings, trainings, and other business-related events. Please note that Oregon Lottery does not reimburse travel expenses. Did you know that the Oregon Lottery is a leader in the gaming industry, and an important contributor of revenue for Oregon's schools, economic development, state parks, watershed restoration, veteran's programs, and outdoor schools? Our impact begins with our workforce; come join our team to be part of the impact.

About the Role:

You will report to the Senior Manager, Go-To-Market Operations and develop and execute operational plans, organize work to meet business strategies, and evaluate functional results. You will guide, develop, and execute strategic marketing plans that support the Lottery’s mission, brand promise, and revenue goals while ensuring compliance with state regulations and responsible gaming standards. You will oversee brand identity, paid media, digital platforms, retail marketing, and external agency partnerships to drive player engagement and support game launches across all product lines. You will manage marketing staff, budgets, analytics, and customer relationship management (CRM) efforts.

You Will:

  • Applies Lottery Management Core Values and Expectations in performing daily activities. Ensures conduct embodies the principles of fairness, integrity, security, and honesty. Supports and integrates into their work the Lottery’s commitment to:
    • Responsible Gambling
    • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
    • Culture of Safety

  • Foster an environment that supports employee success through transparency, communication, and the application of Leadership Behavior Profile principles to guide decision-making, collaboration, and results.

  • Plan, organize, and evaluate the work of the unit while creating and sustaining an engaging and inclusive team culture.

  • Perform supervisory and talent management responsibilities, including aligning individual performance expectations with organizational goals and collaboratively developing performance goals with direct reports.

  • Provide constructive and timely feedback, offer guidance, coaching, and support, ensure professional development plans are in place, and manage ongoing performance.

  • Support employees in addressing and resolving conflicts directly, providing guidance as needed.

  • Create marketing strategies and plans that support revenue goals, game launches, and responsible gaming objectives.

  • Manage the marketing budget, support retailers, and ensure all advertising meets state regulations and responsible gaming standards.

  • Lead paid media management, collaborate with agencies and vendors, support game launches, and execute integrated campaigns across digital, retail, and traditional channels.

  • Manage and evolve the Lottery’s brand identity, ensure consistency across all channels, support messaging development, and maintain alignment with organizational goals.

  • Oversee digital platforms and data-driven player engagement, manage the website, app, and social media presence, and utilize CRM tools and analytics to drive retention and understand player behavior.

You Have:

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONSEducation and Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree and five (5) years of professional experience in marketing with oversight for at least one of the following: brand identity, paid media, digital platforms, or retail marketing. Three (3) years of supervisory or management experience; OR
  • Eight (8) years of professional experience in marketing with oversight for at least one of the following: brand identity, paid media, digital platforms, or retail marketing. Three (3) years of supervisory or management experience.

raw.description:
Req ID:380413

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a PeopleSoft Finance Developer (Techno-Functional) - Remote to join our team in Plano, Texas (US-TX), United States (US).

PeopleSoft Finance Techno-Functional Specialist

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced PeopleSoft Finance Techno-Functional Specialist to support, enhance, and modernize our PeopleSoft Financials and Supply Chain Management (FSCM) environment. This role combines functional expertise with technical development, providing leadership in system support, upgrades, automation, and enterprise application development. The ideal candidate will have deep knowledge of PeopleSoft Finance, strong technical development skills, and an interest in leveraging AI and automation to improve business processes.

Responsibilities

  • Support and maintain the PeopleSoft Financials and Supply Chain Management (FSCM) environment.
  • Manage daily financial batch processing and support month-end and year-end close activities for Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and General Ledger.
  • Troubleshoot application issues, batch failures, and user incidents, performing root cause analysis and implementing long-term solutions.
  • Partner with business users, infrastructure teams, vendors, and external partners to resolve production issues.
  • Lead PeopleTools and PeopleSoft Update Manager (PUM) upgrades, including retrofit analysis, testing, and deployment of customizations.
  • Develop and execute testing strategies, support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and ensure successful implementation of system enhancements.
  • Design, develop, and maintain PeopleSoft customizations using PeopleTools technologies, including Application Engine, PeopleCode, Component Interface, and Approval Workflow Engine (AWE).
  • Configure and support PeopleSoft Finance modules, approval workflows, and integrations with internal and external systems.
  • Develop reports and reporting solutions using PeopleSoft Query, SQR, BI Publisher, and nVision.
  • Design and implement integrations using web services and APIs.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through AI, automation, and modern reporting solutions, including AI agents and intelligent workflow automation.
  • Create functional and technical design documentation and support ongoing application lifecycle management.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
  • 8+ years of experience supporting, developing, and upgrading PeopleSoft Financials and Supply Chain Management (FSCM) applications.
  • Strong functional knowledge of PeopleSoft Financial modules, including:
    • General Ledger (GL)
    • Accounts Payable (AP)
    • Accounts Receivable (AR)
    • Asset Management (AM)
    • Project Costing (PC)
  • Experience supporting Supply Chain modules, including Purchasing, eProcurement, Purchase Orders, and Billing.
  • Experience managing financial batch processing, month-end and year-end close activities, and enterprise interfaces with banking, HR, and supply chain systems.
  • Experience gathering business requirements, conducting fit-gap analysis, and documenting business processes.
  • Strong PeopleTools development experience, including:
    • PeopleCode
    • Application Engine
    • Component Interface
    • Approval Workflow Engine (AWE)
  • Experience developing reports using PeopleSoft Query, SQR, BI Publisher, and nVision.
  • Experience developing and supporting web services and API integrations.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across business and technical teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with PeopleSoft Update Manager (PUM) and PeopleTools upgrade projects.
  • Experience implementing automated testing frameworks and deployment processes.
  • Familiarity with Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, or intelligent automation solutions.
  • Experience developing AI-powered reporting, workflow automation, or enterprise productivity solutions.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments.

This role offers the opportunity to support a mission-critical enterprise ERP platform while driving modernization initiatives through automation, AI, and continuous improvement.

Pay Transparency

Where required by law, NTT DATA provides a reasonable range of compensation for specific roles. The starting pay range for this remote role is $88,200-$183,750. This range reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all US locations. Actual compensation will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s actual work location, relevant experience, technical skills, and other qualifications.

This position is eligible for company benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance with an employer contribution, flexible spending or health savings account, life and AD&D insurance, short- and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program with company match, and additional voluntary or legally-required benefits.

About NTT DATA

NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.

Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, .

We are seeking a highly technical and strategic Senior Developer Relations Manager - EMEA AI Natives to join our team, with a focus on engaging developer ecosystems across emerging technology domains. In this pivotal role, you will work directly with software solution providers, developers, and industry professionals to foster the adoption of NVIDIA’s advanced AI and computing platforms. The ideal candidate brings a blend of deep technical expertise and commercial go-to-market experience, combined with a passion for developer advocacy and a talent for communicating how NVIDIA technology can solve complex, real-world challenges.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Serve as the trusted technical advisor, problem solver, and champion for the developer ecosystem in EMEA AI Natives with multi-functional partners to drive adoption of NVIDIA technologies.

  • Accelerate critical workloads by demonstrating ground breaking solutions that integrate the core NVIDIA stack into developer products, platforms, and pipelines.

  • Advise on the technical enablement resources—such as sample code, guides, demonstration pipelines, and tools to highlight the application of technologies in solving real-world problems for EMEA AI Natives

  • Guide partners and startups through onboarding and integration with NVIDIA’s programs, fostering co-innovation and the development of next-generation solutions.

  • Map, track, and monitor the developer ecosystem to identify growth opportunities, inform technology roadmaps, and shape adoption strategies.

  • Collaborate multi-functionally with solution architects, engineering, product management, and marketing to drive developer engagement and optimize partner adoption strategies.

  • Engage with partner engineering teams, technical leaders, and decision-makers to identify goals, solve technical challenges, and promote best practices for successful integrations.

  • Represent and advocate for the partner technical needs and feedback to NVIDIA’s internal product and engineering teams, supplying actionable insights from field deployments to influence product roadmaps.

What We Need to See:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • A minimum of 8+ years of overall professional experience in the technology industry in software engineering, developer relations, technical partnerships, including 5+ years of direct hands-on experience in your designated ecosystem (e.g., Telco, MarTech, etc.).

  • Proven experience leading, partnering, and scaling developer programs at major technology companies, EMEA AI Natives, ISVs, or within relevant verticals.

  • Significant technical proficiency guiding EMEA AI Natives in high-performance computing, cloud, AI/ML, and/or vertical-specific frameworks and libraries.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to distill complex technical concepts for diverse technical and non-technical audiences from engineers to executives.

  • Experience leading technical collaborations with engineering and product teams - including architectural design, code reviews, technical mentorship, and delivery of technical talks or workshops

  • Proven ability to structure and implement complex technical engagements, negotiate requirements, prioritize issues, and collaborate with internal or external stakeholders (across sales, legal, product or marketing teams as needed).

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:

  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing vertical-specific solutions for Generative & Agentic AI

  • Familiarity with advanced computing, AI, and/or GPU acceleration platforms

  • Track record in crafting and implementing systems for real-time processing and low-latency decision-making.

  • Successful history of building and scaling developer communities and delivering impactful technical enablement programs.

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the world’s most desirable employers! We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to outstanding growth, our best-in-class engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous person with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you.
