SUMMARY:

Claim Representative II:

This is the intermediate level of the claim handler career path. Handles moderate to difficult claims. Exercises progressively more discretion in the determination of compensability of claims. Considers many factors in the determination claim reserves. Negotiates and settles claims within given authority. Works remotely with occasional travel to on-site visits with insured municipalities. Is a resident in the State of Michigan

RESPONSIBILITIES/TASKS:

  • Verifies coverage of claimed property and casualty damage.

  • Determines liability for covered claims by thorough investigation of the claim and applicable exclusions.

  • Analyzes liability for claims pursuant to Michigan municipal liability statutes and caselaw.

  • Establishes timely and appropriate reserves based on the profile of the claim within given authority based on anticipated financial exposure.

  • Documents specifics of claims with potential for subrogation recovery, including amount of potential recovery monies.

  • Manages estimates and invoices for property, casualty and automobile claims, and approves payments based on support showing relationship to the cause of loss and legal liability for payment.

  • Concludes and closes files following resolution of claims to meet internal performance standards while complying with state legislation to avoid penalties and manage expenses.

  • Negotiates settlements with attorneys or injured parties within given authority at the earliest possible point to bring cases to final disposition.

  • Works closely with manager on complex files or files above settlement/reserve authority.

  • Manages outside vendors to ensure cost containment efforts.

  • Establishes and maintains effective working relationships with all internal and external customers.

  • Stays abreast of changes in municipal liability statutes and case law in order to accurately interpret and apply relevant laws.

ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES/TASKS:

  • Administers complex claims and catastrophic exposures within authority, including claims from dedicated large accounts.
  • Exercises independent judgment to settle cases prior to mediation or litigation.
  • Actively participates in agent/client relationship management.
  • Assists in mentoring team members.

This position description identifies the responsibilities and tasks typically associated with the performance of the position. Other relevant essential functions may be required.

EMPLOYMENT QUALIFICATIONS

EDUCATION OR EQUIVALENT EXPERIENCE:

Bachelor’s degree in a related field. Relevant combination of education and experience may be considered in lieu of degree. Continuous learning, as defined by the Company’s learning philosophy, is required. Certification or progress toward certification is highly preferred and encouraged.

EXPERIENCE:

Claim Representative II:

Three years experience in property and casualty claims environment which provides the necessary skills, knowledge and abilities, such as experience in reviewing policy coverages and exclusions, drafting coverage letters, investigating and settling property and casualty losses, and adjusting claims through litigation and trial. Experience handling claims in multiple jurisdictions preferred. Bilingual skills preferred.

SKILLS/KNOWLEDGE/ABILITIES (SKA) REQUIRED:

  • Ability and proficiency in the use of computers and company standard software specific to position.

  • Knowledge of medical and legal terminology related to the work.

  • Knowledge of Michigan municipal liability.

  • Knowledge of best practices for adjusting property losses.

  • Effective oral and written communication skills.

  • Effective customer service skills.

  • Ability to negotiate, build consensus and resolve conflict.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established deadlines.

  • Attention to detail and analytical skills.

  • Ability to work independently as well as within a team.

ADDITIONAL SKILLS/KNOWLEDGE/ABILITIES (SKA) REQUIRED:

Claim Representative II, III:

  • Ability to make independent decisions.
  • Ability to solve complex problems.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

Work is performed in an office setting with no unusual hazards. Minimal travel required.

PAY RANGE:

Actual compensation decision relies on the consideration of internal equity, candidate’s skills and professional experience, geographic location, market, and other potential factors. It is not standard practice for an offer to be at or near the top of the range, and therefore a reasonable estimate for this role is between $56,700 - $94,900.

Job Title: Director of Enterprise Systems

Job Location: Work at Home, Texas, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full time

Job Seniority Level:

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

POSITION SUMMARY

CVS Health Digital is looking for hands-on, passionate people who want to join a high energy and growing team to make a difference in customers’ lives and who want to be on the forefront of digital innovation that aims to reinvent what a pharmacy and a health care company can be in the digital world. Currently, we are seeking a Director of Enterprise Systems who will play a vital role in leading the engineering transformation and optimization of our HP NonStop (Tandem) platform. This Director will provide strategic leadership to HP NonStop infrastructure engineering, DevOps, and automation teams, driving modern engineering practices and ensuring the successful delivery of mission-critical solutions that align with business objectives. The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership experience in enterprise-class platform engineering, with expertise in DevOps methodologies, infrastructure automation, and modern software development practices that can be applied to HP NonStop environments.

Expectations for the Role:

Leadership and Strategy

  • Develop and execute engineering strategies for the HP NonStop infrastructure landscape and the enterprise Performance Engineering practice that align with organizational goals and business objectives, including the integration of artificial intelligence and machine learning capabilities
  • Lead and mentor teams of platform engineers, DevOps specialists, automation engineers, and performance engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and modern engineering practices
  • Recruit, train, and retain high-performing engineering talent with expertise in enterprise platforms, DevOps, automation technologies, performance engineering, and emerging AI-driven solutions
  • Provide thought leadership on platform engineering, DevOps transformation, infrastructure automation, AI-enabled operations, and performance engineering best practices
  • Drive the adoption of modern engineering methodologies including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and site reliability engineering principles within enterprise platform environments
  • Develop strategic performance engineering roadmaps, implement and monitor SLAs, and track team performance metrics across all areas of responsibility

Platform Engineering and DevOps

  • Lead the transformation of HP NonStop systems management through modern DevOps practices, automation frameworks, and AIOps capabilities
  • Architect and implement CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and deployment strategies for HP NonStop applications and infrastructure
  • Drive infrastructure automation initiatives, including AI-assisted operations and predictive analytics, using tools and methodologies that can be adapted to HP NonStop environments
  • Establish monitoring, observability, and alerting solutions that leverage AI-driven anomaly detection to provide comprehensive visibility into HP NonStop system performance and health
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code practices and configuration management for HP NonStop systems
  • Champion containerization, microservices, and cloud-native principles where applicable to HP NonStop workloads

Performance Engineering

  • Supervise and direct the team of Performance Engineers, including contractors
  • Establish and maintain enterprise-wide performance testing standards and drive the adoption of advanced performance monitoring, analytics, and AI-powered predictive capabilities
  • Manage the performance testing intake process and report on project metrics
  • Own enterprise performance testing tools, including LoadRunner, and associated VM server infrastructure
  • Own the non-production development and test environments supporting performance engineering activities
  • Participate in project delivery activities including monthly releases, migrations, upgrades, and deployments

Engineering Excellence and Innovation

  • Lead the design, implementation, and optimization of HP NonStop systems using modern engineering principles
  • Drive API-first development and integration strategies to modernize HP NonStop application interfaces
  • Implement automated testing frameworks, including AI-augmented testing, unit testing, integration testing, and performance testing for HP NonStop applications
  • Establish engineering standards, code review processes, and quality gates for HP NonStop development
  • Foster a culture of experimentation and innovation, encouraging the evaluation and adoption of emerging technologies including artificial intelligence and machine learning
  • Collaborate with architecture teams to design scalable, resilient, and maintainable HP NonStop solutions

Security and Compliance Engineering

  • Implement security-by-design principles and DevSecOps practices for HP NonStop systems
  • Automate security scanning, vulnerability assessment, and compliance reporting processes, leveraging AI-driven threat detection where applicable
  • Design and implement automated security controls and monitoring for HP NonStop environments
  • Drive vulnerability compliance remediations and support audit initiatives across all owned platforms and tooling

Cross-Platform Collaboration and Integration

  • Collaborate with teams managing other enterprise platforms (mainframe, Unix, Linux, cloud) to share best practices and drive consistency
  • Lead integration initiatives between HP NonStop systems and modern cloud platforms, APIs, and microservices
  • Drive standardization of tooling, monitoring, logging, and observability across diverse platform environments

Vendor and Technology Management

  • Establish and maintain relationships with HPE, DevOps tool vendors, performance testing tool vendors, AI and automation platform providers, and contractor vendors
  • Evaluate and implement modern tooling and technologies, including AI-powered solutions, that enhance HP NonStop and performance engineering capabilities
  • Coordinate with vendors for platform modernization, automation tools, and engineering support services

Budget and Resource Management

  • Manage budgets for HP NonStop engineering, performance engineering operations, automation tools, AI initiatives, and platform modernization efforts
  • Make strategic decisions on tooling, technology investments, and resource allocation to maximize engineering efficiency
  • Track and report on engineering productivity metrics, automation ROI, and platform modernization progress

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years of proven experience in enterprise-class platform engineering
  • 7+ years of experience in any of the following platforms: HP NonStop, IBM mainframe (z/OS), IBM iSeries (AS/400), Unix/Linux enterprise systems, or large-scale distributed systems
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing engineering teams, including direct reports and contractors, with a demonstrated ability to drive transformation and foster innovation in complex technical environments
  • Deep expertise in DevOps methodologies, including CI/CD pipeline design, Infrastructure as Code, configuration management, and automated testing frameworks
  • Experience with performance testing methodologies, tools (such as LoadRunner), and quality assurance practices in enterprise environments
  • Proven track record in platform modernization and transformation initiatives in enterprise environments
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, Splunk, or similar platforms
  • Knowledge of API development and integration patterns, microservices architecture, and cloud-native technologies
  • Experience with security automation, DevSecOps practices, and vulnerability compliance remediation in enterprise environments
  • Strong understanding of site reliability engineering (SRE) principles and practices, with a focus on MTTD/MTTR
  • Experience with disaster recovery automation and business continuity planning for critical enterprise systems

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Previous experience with HP NonStop (Tandem) systems, including NonStop OS, NonStop SQL/MX, or NonStop application development
  • Experience with financial services or healthcare transaction processing systems
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and modern software development practices
  • Familiarity with AIOps, AI-driven testing, or machine learning applications in infrastructure management, performance engineering, or security operations
  • Experience managing vendor relationships, technology budgets, and resource allocation for engineering initiatives
  • Experience establishing and maintaining enterprise-wide performance testing standards and strategic performance engineering roadmaps
  • Experience implementing and monitoring SLAs and engineering team performance metrics
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and capacity to manage complex engineering projects across multiple teams and stakeholders
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively with diverse technical and business stakeholders
  • Experience managing non-production development and test environments in large enterprise settings
  • ITIL Foundation or higher
  • AWS, Azure, or GCP cloud certifications
  • DevOps or SRE-related certifications (e.g., AWS DevOps Engineer, Google SRE, Docker/Kubernetes certifications)
  • Performance testing certifications (e.g., ISTQB Performance Testing, LoadRunner certification)

EDUCATION

Bachelor’s degree or, equivalent experience (HS diploma + 4 years relevant experience)

BUSINESS OVERVIEW

Bring your heart to CVS Health Every one of us at CVS Health shares a single, clear purpose: Bringing our heart to every moment of your health. This purpose guides our commitment to deliver enhanced human-centric health care for a rapidly changing world. Anchored in our brand — with heart at its center — our purpose sends a personal message that how we deliver our services is just as important as what we deliver. Our Heart At Work Behaviors™ support this purpose. We want everyone who works at CVS Health to feel empowered by the role they play in transforming our culture and accelerating our ability to innovate and deliver solutions to make health care more personal, convenient and affordable. We strive to promote and sustain a culture of diversity, inclusion and belonging every day. CVS Health is an affirmative action employer, and is an equal opportunity employer, as are the physician-owned businesses for which CVS Health provides management services. We do not discriminate in recruiting, hiring, promotion, or any other personnel action based on race, ethnicity, color, national origin, sex/gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We proudly support and encourage people with military experience (active, veterans, reservists and National Guard) as well as military spouses to apply for CVS Health job opportunities.

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:

$144,200.00 - $288,400.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. This position also includes an award target in the company’s equity award program.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

Job Title: Lead Instructor: MLOps / AI Platform Engineering

Company: General Assembly

Client: Confidential – Customer Success Reskilling

Location: Remote (Must work West Coast / Pacific Time hours)

Duration: 2 Weeks (Starting Mid-June)

Commitment: Roughly 30 hours per week

Compensation: $11,500 - $15,500 (Estimated lump sum payment for one 60-hour program)

About the Engagement

General Assembly is delivering a specialized reskilling program designed to transition Customer Success and Account Management professionals into MLOps and AI Platform Engineering roles.

As the Lead Instructor, you will be the face of lessons. You aren't just checking the math; you are bridge-building. You will lead experienced customer-facing professionals through the complexities of taking AI systems from pilot to production, ensuring they leave the 2-week intensive with a functional understanding of MLOps governance and deployment.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead Live Instruction: Deliver high-energy, synchronous remote lectures and "prompt-along" sessions covering ML pipelines, model deployment, and monitoring.
  • Simplify the Complex: Translate high-level MLOps concepts (CI/CD for ML, governance frameworks) into digestible insights for learners who are experienced professionals but not career engineers.
  • Facilitate Hands-on Labs: Guide students through self-paced exercises and live troubleshooting within the Azure AI Foundry and ML environments.
  • Mentor & Office Hours: Provide real-time feedback during dedicated lab hours, helping students navigate technical roadblocks in Python and Azure infrastructure.
  • Drive Learning Outcomes: Ensure students can successfully articulate and execute model lifecycle management strategies by the end of the cohort.

What You Bring

  • The Experience: 7+ years in software or data engineering, with at least 3+ years specifically in MLOps or ML platform roles in a production environment.
  • The "Teacher" Gene: Proven experience in technical instruction, bootcamp delivery, or corporate training. You should be comfortable "reading the room" in a virtual setting.
  • Azure Fluency: Deep, hands-on expertise with Azure ML and AI Foundry. You should be able to navigate these platforms in your sleep.
  • Technical Foundation: Proficiency in Python, Data Engineering fundamentals, and applying DevOps/CI/CD principles specifically to ML workloads.
  • The Credentials: AZ-900, AI-900, and DP-100 are required; AI-102 is preferred.
  • The Pedigree: Experience as an AI Platform or Azure ML engineer at a major tech firm (Microsoft, Google, etc.) is a massive plus.

Note on Schedule: This is a high-intensity, 2-week engagement. Candidates must be fully available for 30 hours per week during the mid-June window and be prepared to operate on Pacific Time (PT) schedules to align with the learner cohort.

Unless otherwise noted, remote positions can be performed from the following approved General Assembly operating countries.

United States of America (states of operation may vary), Canada (provinces of operation may vary), United Kingdom, Australia, and Singapore.

raw.description:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a highly driven, execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Senior Operations Manager opening.

As the Senior Operations Manager, you are the company's logistics engine — owning and driving end-to-end execution across suppliers, freight, inventory, and fulfillment. You don't just manage operations — you obsess over them. Every shipment is tracked, every forwarder is held accountable, and every purchase order is placed with full awareness of its financial impact.

You lead by doing — raising the execution bar of the team through hands-on involvement, system building, and continuous improvement. You actively leverage AI, not as a tool, but as a core operational layer — building systems, automations, and workflows that improve visibility, accuracy, and decision-making.

This is not a role for someone who wants to maintain what exists. It is for someone hungry to improve, optimize, and prove they can operate at a high-performance level.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities:

Own Supply Chain Execution & Pipeline Visibility

  • Maintain live pipeline visibility at all times — including China warehouse status, vessels in transit (ETD/ETA), and inventory received stateside. The pipeline never surprises the business.
  • Deliver month-end inventory snapshots and quarter-end reconciliations to finance without being asked.
  • Ensure AI systems automatically flag anomalies across the pipeline (delays, mismatches, risks).
  • Ensure 100% on-time product launches, QC pass rate >98% on first inspection, and On Time In Full (OTIF) >95% by Month 6.
  • Maintain >98% in-stock rate on top revenue SKUs, aged inventory <8% of total units, and drive inventory turns toward 5–8x annually.
  • Secure a minimum of 3 freight quotes per booking and ensure no forwarder is retained without performance data (ETD accuracy, delays, cost benchmarks).
  • Maintain and update a rolling 12-week supply plan, with AI-driven risk detection and reorder triggers before stockouts occur.

Drive Financial Discipline in Operations

  • Maintain a standing financial analysis for every active supplier — including cash flow impact, landed cost, and MOQ trade-offs — continuously updated via AI-powered tools.
  • Ensure no purchase order is committed to excess inventory without documented financial justification.
  • Track landed cost against target COGS on every order.
  • Deliver a monthly operations cost summary (freight, duty, storage, COGS trends) — compiled and formatted automatically via AI tools.
  • Ensure 100% application of Nairobi Protocol and all applicable duty exemptions.
  • Build and maintain an AI system that verifies HS codes and eligibility before every freight booking — zero exceptions.

Build SOPs & Scalable Systems

  • Conduct a full operational audit within the first 60 days, clearly identifying what is working, broken, missing, and where AI can enhance execution.
  • First 30 days are dedicated to learning, not restructuring, followed by a prioritized improvement roadmap presented to the Head of Operations.
  • Ensure all SOPs are documented, tested, live in Asana, and followed without supervision.
  • Audit every SOP for AI acceleration opportunities.
  • Build and implement at least 2 AI-powered tools within the first 6 months, and document and hand them off as repeatable team processes.
  • Ensure SOPs are reviewed quarterly and continuously optimized.

Own DTC Fulfillment & Inventory Strategy

  • Ensure all supply planning accounts for total demand across all channels (Amazon, DTC, wholesale, and emerging channels) — no decision is made without a full demand picture.
  • Maintain an AI-powered demand model that continuously updates forecasts and surfaces risks.
  • Ensure DTC and Amazon inventory pools never compete for the same units, with AI monitoring stock levels and reorder thresholds.
  • Own DTC fulfillment performance end-to-end — cost, lead time, and service level — escalating issues with proposed solutions before customer impact.

Lead and Develop the Operations Team

  • Assess all team members within the first 30 days, identifying strengths, gaps, and development needs.
  • Define clear ownership and weekly KPIs for each team member, ensuring accountability and independent execution.
  • Address performance gaps within 7 days — no prolonged underperformance.
  • Ensure no team member requires daily oversight on core responsibilities.
  • Coach the team on financial awareness and AI adoption, ensuring each team member delivers at least one AI-driven workflow improvement within the first 6 months.

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Amazon FBA operations, including shipment creation, AWD, inventory management, and compliance.
  • Proven experience managing overseas suppliers (preferably China), booking freight with multiple forwarders, and handling customs and duty optimization.
  • Strong experience managing inventory across multiple fulfillment channels, with a track record of maintaining high in-stock rates and controlling aged inventory.
  • Experience leading and managing a team (minimum 2 direct reports), with clear evidence of accountability and performance management.
  • Proven experience building, following, and improving SOPs and operational processes.
  • Hands-on experience building AI tools, automations, or workflows is strongly preferred.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to detail: does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
  • Commitment (Work ethic): possesses a strong willingness to work hard and sometimes long hours to get the job done.
  • Consistency (Persistency): demonstrates tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done.
  • Growth (Growth mindset): continuously seeks to learn, improve, and grow.
  • Problem solver (Proactivity): acts without being told what to do and brings new ideas.
  • Trust (Honesty/integrity): operates with transparency and high ethical standards.

Leadership Competencies:

  • Efficiency: builds systems that maximize output and eliminate wasted effort.
  • Analytical skills: applies financial thinking to every operational decision.
  • Organization & Planning: manages multiple complex workflows without failure.
  • Calm under pressure: maintains performance and clarity in high-stress situations.
  • High standards: operates with a zero-error mindset on execution and reporting.
  • Enthusiasm: brings energy and passion for logistics, AI, and operational excellence.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Direct ownership of critical operations and supply chain performance.
  • High impact role with significant autonomy and decision-making power.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture.

Contribute to CRS’s mission of serving poor and vulnerable communities by developing compelling, donor-focused proposals that secure resources for high-impact programs. As a member of the global Business Development (BD) Support Team, provide surge support for strategic funding opportunities across the agency, partnering with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and deliver competitive proposals. Roles and Key Responsibilities

Providing BD Surge Support:

  • Serve as lead writer for concept notes, expression of interests, and proposals. Develop technical narrative outlines and draft proposal sections with input from the technical design lead and other proposal team members. Ensure local context and knowledge is fully reflected in proposal products.
  • Collaborate with the proposal coordinator, technical design lead and sector leads, other proposal team members and stakeholders, including partners, to develop well-written, well-organized and cohesive concept notes, expressions of interest and proposals aligned with donor requirements and CRS standards.

  • Manage communications with the technical design lead and proposal coordinator throughout the proposal development process to ensure expectations are aligned and deadlines are met.
  • Serve as editor for complex technical proposals, editing in accordance with AP and CRS house style, focusing on improving readability by shortening sentences, eliminating redundancies, rearranging sentences to improve transitions and clarifying exhibits and references.
  • Support other writing/editing tasks (including reports, donor facing marketing material, executive communication, etc.), less than 10% of the time.

Supporting Relevant CRS Communities of Practice:

  • Serve as an active member of the CRS Writer Community of Practice, collaborating on joint projects and deliverables, supporting other members with guidance and attending relevant meetings.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong communication and relationship management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to contribute as part of a team to produce high-quality deliverables under tight deadlines.

Required Languages: Fluency in oral and written English required. Working ability in French or Spanish a plus.

Travel: Must be willing and able to travel internationally approximately 35% of the time

Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

raw.title: Wyoming Rural Healthcare Human Resources Leadership Opportunities

raw.description:
Wyoming Rural Healthcare Human Resources Leadership Opportunities

Rural Staffing Services partners with rural hospitals, clinics, public hospital districts, community health centers, and healthcare organizations throughout Wyoming to identify experienced human resources leaders who understand the importance of supporting both employees and the communities they serve.

We are currently connecting with professionals who may be interested in active and upcoming human resources, talent, workforce, and employee relations leadership opportunities across Wyoming.

These opportunities may include leadership within Critical Access Hospitals, Rural Health Clinics, Federally Qualified Health Centers, community hospitals, public hospital districts, long-term care organizations, and integrated rural healthcare systems.

Explore Rural Healthcare Opportunities at RSSJobs.org

This application may connect you with the specific opportunity you were viewing, as well as other current or upcoming rural healthcare positions throughout Wyoming that align with your experience and goals.

Visit to explore additional rural healthcare opportunities and communities.

This Is More Than an HR Role

In rural healthcare, human resources plays a central role in whether an organization can recruit, retain, and support the people needed to care for the community.

HR leaders often work across every department and help shape the employee experience from the first conversation through onboarding, development, retention, and long-term engagement.

The strongest rural HR leaders are approachable, thoughtful, and trusted. They understand employment law and policy, but they also understand people. They can support employees, advise leaders, navigate difficult situations, and help build a workplace where people feel respected and valued.

In smaller rural organizations, HR leaders may have broad responsibility across recruitment, employee relations, benefits, compensation, compliance, workforce planning, and culture.

Opportunities May Include

This application may connect you with current or upcoming roles such as:

  • Human Resources Director
  • Human Resources Manager
  • Vice President of Human Resources
  • Chief Human Resources Officer
  • People and Culture Director
  • Employee Relations Director or Manager
  • Talent Acquisition Director or Manager
  • Workforce Development Director
  • Recruitment Manager
  • Benefits and Compensation Manager
  • HR Business Partner Leadership
  • Organizational Development Leadership
  • Learning and Development Leadership
  • Payroll and HR Operations Leadership
  • Senior HR generalist or supervisory roles

What You May Lead

Responsibilities will vary by organization and position and may include:

  • Providing strategic and operational leadership for human resources
  • Supporting recruitment, onboarding, retention, and workforce planning
  • Advising executives, managers, and employees on workplace matters
  • Strengthening employee engagement, communication, and organizational culture
  • Leading employee relations, investigations, and conflict resolution
  • Overseeing compensation, benefits, leave administration, and HR operations
  • Supporting performance management and leadership development
  • Developing and maintaining policies, procedures, and employee handbooks
  • Ensuring compliance with employment laws, regulations, and organizational standards
  • Supporting labor relations or collective bargaining, when applicable
  • Managing credentialing, background checks, or workforce compliance processes
  • Improving HR systems, reporting, and documentation
  • Building recruitment strategies for hard-to-fill rural healthcare roles
  • Supporting organizational change, restructuring, growth, or leadership transitions
  • Helping employees and leaders feel informed, supported, and heard

What You Will Bring

Qualifications will vary by opportunity, but organizations may seek:

  • Progressive human resources leadership experience
  • Experience as an HR Director, HR Manager, HR Business Partner, Talent Acquisition leader, or comparable professional
  • Knowledge of employment law, employee relations, recruitment, benefits, compensation, and HR compliance
  • Experience advising executives and department leaders
  • Strong communication, discretion, and conflict-resolution skills
  • Experience building or improving HR policies, systems, and processes
  • Experience with healthcare workforce challenges and hard-to-fill positions
  • Rural hospital, Critical Access Hospital, FQHC, public hospital district, long-term care, or community healthcare experience
  • A bachelor's degree in human resources, business, healthcare administration, or a related field
  • Relevant certification such as SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR may be preferred
  • A collaborative, fair, and relationship-focused leadership style

Why Rural Wyoming?

Wyoming's rural healthcare organizations serve communities surrounded by mountains, high plains, ranchlands, rivers, open roads, and wide-open spaces. These organizations often compete for talent with larger systems while relying on smaller teams to carry broad responsibilities.

Human resources leadership in a rural setting offers the opportunity to shape culture, strengthen retention, support leaders, and help ensure the organization has the people it needs to continue serving the community.

Join the RSS Rural Talent Network

By applying through this page, you are joining the confidential Rural Staffing Services talent network. You may be considered for current or upcoming human resources leadership opportunities that align with your experience, goals, location preferences, and availability.

Please submit your resume and let us know:

  • Which Wyoming communities or regions you would consider
  • Whether you are open to relocation
  • Whether you are interested in permanent, interim, remote, or multiple types of opportunities
  • Which position or community you were viewing on RSSJobs.org

Our team personally reviews each application. When we identify an opportunity that may be a strong match, we will contact you directly to share more about the organization, community, workforce needs, and next steps.

Your information will be handled professionally and confidentially.

Discover More Rural Healthcare Opportunities

Visit to explore additional rural healthcare positions, leadership opportunities, and communities throughout Wyoming.

Work Where It Matters.

Built for Rural.

Lumanity is dedicated to improving health outcomes by accelerating and optimizing access to life-changing medicines. As a global strategic partner that brings together strategy, evidence, engagement, and technology, we were designed to engineer breakthrough value to tackle our clients’ toughest challenges by revolutionizing how value is generated, demonstrated, and communicated.

Responsibilities / Position overview

We're seeking a strategic, commercially focused leader to drive the growth and evolution of our global Value, Access & Outcomes (VAO) practice. This highly visible leadership role will define and execute commercial strategy across our Market Access, Health Economics & Outcomes Research (HEOR), Patient-Centered Outcomes (PCO), and Real-World Evidence (RWE) service lines.

Working closely with practice leadership, you'll strengthen commercial performance, enhance business development capabilities, and create scalable strategies that support long-term growth across a global consulting organization

As Commercial Strategy Lead, you'll serve as a strategic partner to business leaders while driving commercial excellence across the VAO practice globally. You will:

  • Develop and execute commercial growth strategies that expand market presence, strengthen competitive positioning, and drive sustainable revenue growth.
  • Partner with practice leadership to refine service offerings, value propositions, and go-to-market strategies across multiple consulting businesses.
  • Lead initiatives that improve commercial operations, sales effectiveness, and business development processes while creating greater consistency across service lines.
  • Design and implement scalable sales enablement programs, including tools, frameworks, KPIs, reporting, and best practices that improve commercial performance.
  • Oversee account planning, pipeline management, forecasting, and opportunity prioritization to maximize growth across strategic clients.
  • Partner with senior business development leaders and consulting teams to strengthen client relationships, improve proposal quality, and increase win rates.
  • Use market intelligence, commercial analytics, and performance data to identify trends, evaluate business performance, and inform strategic decision-making.
  • Collaborate with marketing leadership to align commercial priorities with demand generation, thought leadership, and client engagement initiatives.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing business development team while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

We're looking for a strategic commercial leader who combines strong business acumen with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive organizational growth.

We're looking for someone with:

  • 15+ years of experience in commercial strategy, business development, sales leadership, revenue operations, or a related commercial function within life sciences consulting, healthcare, or professional services.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing commercial growth strategies across complex, matrixed organizations.
  • Experience leading sales enablement, commercial operations, account management, or revenue optimization initiatives that deliver measurable business results.
  • Deep understanding of business development, pipeline management, CRM platforms, forecasting, and commercial performance metrics.
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business decisions.
  • Experience partnering with executive leadership across multiple functions and global teams.
  • Proven ability to lead, coach, and develop high-performing commercial or business development teams.
  • Exceptional communication, relationship-building, and executive influencing skills.
  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA or other advanced degree preferred.

Benefits

We offer our employees a comprehensive benefits package that focuses on what matters to you – health and well-being, personal finances, professional development, and a healthy work/life balance:

  • Competitive salary plus bonus scheme
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance options
  • 401(k) plan with employer match
  • Flexible paid time off program + 10 paid holidays
  • Flexible spending accounts for health and dependent care
  • Health savings account option with employer contribution
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Paid short-term and long-term disability coverage
  • Company-paid life insurance coverage at 1.5x annual salary
  • Paid parental leave and more

raw.description:
Position: Copy Editor

Location: US (remote)

Role Overview:

Jerusalem News Syndicate (JNS), the fastest-growing news agency covering Israel and the Jewish world, is seeking a full-time Copy Editor to join our editorial team. This is a fully remote role open to anyone in the United States.

The ideal candidate will have experience in copy editing for English news publication, a strong understanding of the US/Israel political landscape, and a commitment to our mission. This role requires sharp attention to detail, excellent writing and editing skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced news environment. Responsibilities include proofreading, copyediting, and publishing content via WordPress, covering opinion pieces, news articles, and press releases. The Copy Editor will also participate in editorial meetings and collaborate with supervisors to ensure the highest editorial standards.

What You’ll Do:

  • Proofread and copyedit a continuous stream of opinion pieces, briefs, news and feature articles, press releases, and aggregated content about Israel and the Jewish world to a consistent high quality in a timely manner.
  • Flag and correct factual errors and inconsistencies, including verifying names, dates, statistics, quotes, and links, including following up with writers when information is unclear or unverifiable
  • Check for plagiarism as needed for each story
  • Edit headlines, subheads, and photo captions to improve clarity and accuracy
  • Ensure that all texts conform to JNS editorial standards and abide by the highest quality
  • Publishing finished articles to the CMS
  • Update the website as needed (i.e. uploading breaking news items)

What You Bring:

  • 2+ years of copyediting experience at news/media publications, with expertise in US/Israel political issues, Jewish topics, and online publishing
  • Native English speaker
  • Solid understanding of the Israel/US political landscape and Global/American Jewish communities
  • Proficiency in WordPress and related content-management tools
  • Strong editorial background with excellent proofreading, communication, and adherence to style guides.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and work both independently and collaboratively.
  • Experience in fact-checking and plagiarism detection is a plus.
  • Must reside and be eligible to legally work in the US

Why JNS

  • Be part of a mission-driven organization dedicated to journalistic integrity.
  • Work in an innovative and collaborative environment with opportunities for professional growth.
  • Join a passionate team committed to delivering high-quality news coverage.

About Us:

Jerusalem News Syndicate (JNS) is the fastest-growing news agency covering Israel and the Jewish world. We provide news, briefs, features, opinions, and analysis to 100 print newspapers and digital publications on a daily basis.

We are dedicated to upholding the highest standards of journalism, ensuring accuracy and honesty in all our communications regarding Jewish concerns. Our team is committed to uncovering and refuting false narratives while delivering fully reported and credible material.

POSITION SUMMARY

Processes credentialing and re-credentialing applications of health care practitioners/providers. Monitors Credentialing group inbox to ensure all emails are addressed. Researches and solves participation issues as they arise. Supports the financial goals of the company by being fiscally responsible in all areas, including staffing and purchasing.

Key Performance Areas

KPA 1 – Credentialing & Provider Enrollment Management

  • Coordinate and process initial credentialing, re-credentialing, enrollment, reenrollment, provider updates, and reappointments with commercial payers, government agencies, hospitals, and licensing entities.

  • Prepare, review, and submit credentialing applications accurately, ensuring completeness and compliance with payer, regulatory, accreditation, and organizational requirements.

  • Manage provider participation to support timely onboarding and uninterrupted network participation.

KPA 2 – Provider Data Integrity & Compliance

  • Maintain accurate provider records within credentialing systems, CAQH, payer portals, and related databases.

  • Obtain, verify, and maintain all required credentialing documentation, including licenses, certifications, board certifications, malpractice coverage, DEA registrations, and curriculum vitae.

  • Monitor licensure, certifications, insurance, and credential expiration dates to ensure continuous compliance and prevent lapses in participation.

  • Maintain audit-ready files and support accreditation surveys, delegated credentialing activities, and regulatory compliance reviews.

KPA 3 – Credentialing Coordination & Stakeholder Support

  • Serve as the primary credentialing contact for assigned providers, payers, hospitals, and internal departments.

  • Monitor application progress, confirm receipt and submission, and proactively follow up with external organizations to meet established turnaround times.

  • Collaborate with Provider Relations, Operations, Revenue Cycle, Billing, Compliance, and leadership to support provider onboarding and operational readiness.

  • Monitor the Credentialing team inbox to ensure timely response to provider, payer, and internal inquiries.

KPA 4 – Issue Resolution & Operational Support

  • Research, investigate, and resolve credentialing, enrollment, provider participation, and demographic discrepancies to minimize delays.

  • Escalate credentialing issues, denials, missing documentation, provider non-responsiveness, and other risks impacting participation or reimbursement.

  • Support departmental initiatives and perform additional credentialing and provider data management responsibilities as assigned.

KPA 5 – Reporting, Performance & Process Improvement

  • Maintain complete documentation of credentialing activities and communications within designated tracking systems.

  • Generate credentialing status reports, aging reports, productivity metrics, and other operational reports.

  • Prioritize a high-volume workload while meeting quality, productivity, and turnaround standards.

  • Participate in workflow improvements, departmental projects, and process enhancement initiatives to improve efficiency and service delivery.

  • Maintain current knowledge of credentialing standards, payer requirements, regulatory updates, and industry best practices.

KPA 6 – Financial Stewardship

  • Support organizational financial objectives by ensuring efficient credentialing operations that minimize reimbursement delays and provider participation interruptions.

  • Demonstrate fiscal responsibility through effective resource utilization and adherence to departmental budget and purchasing practices.

Job Description: Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud Developer

Position: Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud Developer (2 Positions)

Experience Level: Mid to Senior (4+ Years)

Type: Contract / Full-time (Initial 3–6 months, extendable based on project needs)

Location: Remote / Offshore

Job Overview

We are seeking two skilled Salesforce Developers with hands-on experience in Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud (LSC) or Health Cloud, and strong expertise in Vlocity/OmniStudio, to join our dynamic team. You will play a key role in building and configuring an Out-of-the-box Subscription Product (OSP) offering, accelerators, and demo environments for our Life Sciences Cloud practice. You will work closely with onshore architects and domain experts to deliver scalable, compliant, and industry-specific Salesforce solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, configure, and customize Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud or Health Cloud solutions based on business requirements.
  • Utilize Vlocity/OmniStudio tools (DataRaptors, Integration Procedures, Calculation Matrices, OmniScripts, FlexCards) to build industry-specific functionality.
  • Assist in building and documenting a reusable OSP (Out-of-the-box Subscription Product) offering for life sciences clients.
  • Develop accelerators and demo environments for key personas (Sales Rep, Key Account Manager, MSL).
  • Collaborate with onshore architects and business analysts to translate business use cases into technical user stories and configurations.
  • Participate in data modeling, object design, and integration with external systems (e.g., EHR, CRM data sources).
  • Follow Salesforce best practices for security, performance, and compliance (especially for life sciences/pharma domain).
  • Support the migration/cloning of OSP environments for new client onboarding.
  • Provide technical documentation and knowledge transfer to other team members.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 4+ years of Salesforce development experience.
  • Must have: Hands-on experience with Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud or Salesforce Health Cloud.
  • Must have: Strong experience with Vlocity/OmniStudio (OmniScripts, DataRaptors, Integration Procedures, Calculation Matrices, FlexCards).
  • Proficiency in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Aura Components, and Flows.
  • Experience with Salesforce data model customization and integration (REST/SOAP APIs).
  • Understanding of life sciences/pharma commercial processes (HCP targeting, call planning, account management, KOL engagement) is a strong plus.
  • Salesforce certifications such as:
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I/II
  • Health Cloud Accredited Professional
  • Vlocity/OmniStudio Developer Certification
  • Good communication skills and ability to work in a cross-functional, distributed team.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with Agent Force or Field Service modules.
  • Knowledge of CLM (Contract Lifecycle Management) or CPQ in life sciences context.
  • Understanding of compliance needs (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, Sunshine Act).
  • Prior experience in building accelerators or reusable industry solutions.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.

raw.description:
Investment Associate

The analytical, transactional and communications engine of a lean investment team

Function: Investment & Investment Operations
Reporting to: CEO & COO
Location: Abu Dhabi, ADGM
Working arrangement: Remote

The Role

Role Purpose

The Investment Associate supports the origination, evaluation, execution and monitoring of investments across the Firm, its Funds and the SPVs through which investments are held.

Working closely with the CEO, COO and CFO, the role provides the analytical, transactional and communications support required by a lean investment team—from initial screening and SPV establishment through to transaction completion, portfolio monitoring and investor reporting.

This is a hands-on position offering broad exposure across investment management, deal execution, investor relations and investment operations.

Why This Role, Now

The Firm has onboarded executive management, including a Chief Operating Officer and Chief Financial Officer, and is building the operational platform required for its next stage of growth.

The Firm is digitalising its operations through a governed document-management system, a centralised action register and a scalable, automated operating model supporting a deliberately lean team.

This position forms part of the next stage of the Firm's growth and platform development.

Key Responsibilities

Investment and Deal Execution

  • Manage live transactions from commencement through to completion under the COO's direction.
  • Coordinate transaction timetables, data rooms, counterparties and external advisers.
  • Support commercial, financial, legal and operational due diligence.
  • Monitor transaction requirements, outstanding actions and closing deliverables.
  • Ensure transaction records and supporting documentation remain complete and audit-ready.

Financial Analysis and Modelling

  • Build and maintain financial models, valuations and sensitivity analyses.
  • Conduct commercial, market, industry and counterparty due diligence.
  • Analyse financial performance, operating metrics and investment risks.
  • Prepare clear recommendations and supporting analysis for investment decisions.
  • Review investment assumptions and identify material risks, sensitivities and value drivers.

Investment Memoranda and Committee Papers

  • Prepare investment memoranda, Investment Committee papers and transaction summaries.
  • Produce post-completion reviews and portfolio updates.
  • Ensure all materials are prepared to a Board-ready and investor-ready standard.
  • Coordinate supporting information and respond to questions arising during the approval process.

SPV Establishment and Administration

  • Work with the COO to establish and maintain investment SPVs.
  • Coordinate with external legal counsel, outsourced service providers and the fund administrator.
  • Support the preparation of constitutional documents, registers, bank accounts and closing documentation.
  • Manage SPV establishment and transaction-closing mechanics.
  • Maintain accurate and complete records throughout the SPV lifecycle.

Portfolio Monitoring and Investment Pipeline

  • Monitor portfolio performance, financial results and key operating indicators.
  • Support the CFO's quarterly valuation process using IPEV methodology.
  • Gather and analyse underlying financial and operational data from portfolio companies.
  • Maintain portfolio schedules, investment records and performance reporting.
  • Support origination through funding-round tracking, secondary-market monitoring and broker-flow analysis.
  • Maintain the investment target pipeline and transaction schedules.
  • Identify and escalate emerging market, sector and investment themes to the CEO and COO.

Investor Relations and Communications

  • Support fundraising activities and ongoing investor communications.
  • Prepare quarterly investor reports, presentations and other reporting materials.
  • Coordinate responses to due diligence questionnaires and investor information requests.
  • Prepare and maintain investor data-room content.
  • Ensure communications are accurate and appropriate for Professional Clients and Market Counterparties.
  • Contribute to investor presentations, updates and transaction announcements.

Investment Operations

  • Establish and maintain transaction, investor and portfolio data rooms.
  • Complete due diligence questionnaires and support investor due diligence processes.
  • Support Limited Partner onboarding, KYC and AML documentation requirements.
  • Assist with the administration of capital calls and distributions.
  • Act as a day-to-day liaison with the outsourced fund administrator.
  • Maintain complete, accurate and audit-ready investment and investor records.
  • Support ongoing compliance, governance and regulatory reporting requirements.

Process and Operational Development

  • Contribute to the development of the Firm's operations manual and standard operating procedures.
  • Document and improve processes across fund operations, the SPV lifecycle, investor onboarding and investor reporting.
  • Support the implementation of scalable digital workflows and automated operating processes.
  • Identify operational gaps and recommend practical improvements.

Digital Profile and Firm Communications

  • Manage and update the Firm's website, LinkedIn page and other relevant communication channels.
  • Contribute to transaction announcements, market updates and thought-leadership content.
  • Ensure public communications are professional, accurate and consistent with the Firm's regulatory obligations.

General Firm Support

  • Contribute to the broader operation of a small, regulated investment firm.
  • Support record-keeping, management information and internal reporting.
  • Assist colleagues across functions where required.
  • Undertake other responsibilities typical of an associate position within a growing investment-management firm.

Candidate Profile

Qualifications

  • CFA Level III candidate or recently qualified CFA preferred.
  • Strong degree in finance, economics, accounting, business or a related discipline.
  • CA, CPA or ACCA qualifications are also highly regarded and may be considered alongside or in place of the CFA.

Experience

  • Approximately 2–5 years of relevant experience in investment management, private markets, investment banking or corporate finance.
  • Demonstrated transaction-execution and financial-modelling experience.
  • Private equity or venture capital experience is preferred.
  • Familiarity with investment funds, SPVs and private-market structures is advantageous.
  • Experience preparing investment memoranda, valuations, investor materials or Investment Committee papers is highly regarded.
  • Exposure to investor onboarding, KYC, fund administration or portfolio reporting is beneficial.

Technical Capabilities

  • Strong financial modelling, valuation and analytical skills.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint capabilities.
  • Ability to interpret financial statements, operating metrics and transaction documents.
  • Strong written communication and presentation skills.
  • High attention to detail and disciplined document-management practices.
  • Familiarity with IPEV valuation methodology is advantageous.

Personal Attributes

  • A practical problem solver who identifies gaps and takes responsibility for closing them.
  • Highly motivated, adaptable and willing to contribute across all areas of the business.
  • Collaborative and comfortable supporting colleagues outside the immediate scope of the role.
  • Commercially minded, organised and capable of managing competing priorities.
  • Discreet and trustworthy when handling confidential Board, Investment Committee, portfolio and investor information.
  • Comfortable working in a lean team where initiative, accountability and execution are essential.

Working Style

  • Able to operate effectively and independently in a remote environment.
  • Disciplined in maintaining records, deadlines, communication and reporting cadence.
  • Proactive in providing updates and escalating issues.
  • Comfortable working across multiple transactions, stakeholders and time zones.
  • Able to maintain institutional-quality standards without requiring close supervision.

Working Arrangement

This position is offered on a remote basis. The Firm is headquartered in Abu Dhabi Global Market and operates as a distributed team.

The successful candidate must:

  • Work core hours aligned with Gulf Standard Time.
  • Be available to travel to Abu Dhabi periodically when required.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality and information-security standards.
  • Comply with all document-management, record-keeping and regulatory requirements.
  • Handle material relating to the Board, Investment Committee, portfolio companies and Limited Partners to the same professional standard regardless of working location.

About the Firm

The Firm is an active technology investor headquartered in Abu Dhabi Global Market and regulated by the Financial Services Regulatory Authority.

It specialises in late-stage and pre-IPO investment opportunities across artificial intelligence, compute infrastructure, space, deep technology and fintech. Investors are provided access to private-market opportunities through professionally governed SPV structures.

The Firm has invested in more than 30 companies with a combined net asset value exceeding US$400 million. It is expanding its regulatory permissions to support the launch of pooled investment funds across private equity, venture capital and real estate.

The Firm serves a sophisticated investor base that includes sovereign wealth funds, financial institutions, family offices and professional investors. This position offers broad exposure to the development and scaling of an institutional investment platform.

How to Apply

This position description is indicative. As a growing regulated firm with a lean team, responsibilities may be shaped around the particular strengths and capabilities of the successful candidate.

Candidates who closely match the requirements and demonstrate strong capability are encouraged to apply, even if they do not meet every listed criterion.

Expressions of interest should be submitted through the introducing recruitment consultant.

raw.description:
About the job

The Creative Technologist will support the Android Brand and Google Play Creative team by building the tools, workflows, demos, and prototypes that help creative ideas get stronger and move faster.

This role has two connected parts. First, you will help improve the team’s creative process by building internal tools and AI-enabled workflows for briefing, ideation, prototyping, review, production, localization, and scale. Second, you will help turn Google product capabilities into campaign ideas, product demos, prototypes, and consumer-facing stories.

You will work closely with creative leads, brand marketers, designers, writers, PMMs, producers, product managers, engineers, and external partners to make ideas tangible. The strongest candidate will bring technical fluency, creative judgment, product accuracy, and a builder’s mindset.

What we are looking for

We are seeing a Creative Technologist who is excited by emerging technology and can help the Android Brand and Google Play Creative team move faster, think sharper, and make more original work by turning emerging technology into useful tools, demos, prototypes, and creative workflows.

This role sits between creative, product, and technology. You will help articulate campaign ideas, translate product capabilities into clear consumer stories, and make those ideas tangible.

The right candidate is part creative thinker, part technical maker, part systems builder, and part AI craftsperson. You should be able to move quickly across AI tools, Figma, lightweight code, APIs, no-code/low-code platforms, and production tools to help teams see what is possible and make stronger creative decisions.

Job Summary

The Senior Director, Commercial Pricing Strategy will serve as the commercial pricing authority within the Support Services Hub. This role is responsible for building and leading pricing strategy, deal economics, benchmarking, and analytics for Facilities Management and Support Services.

The role partners across a matrixed organization to ensure commercial models are competitive, executable, and aligned to long‑term growth and value creation.

This role is remote and requires up to 25% travel.

1. Own Commercial Pricing Strategy

  • Cross‑selling across services and sectors
  • Bundled and integrated offerings
  • Long‑term contracts with cost‑savings or performance‑based incentives
  • Test and refine models such as gainshare, stepped maturity pricing, and outcome‑linked fees

5. Partner with Sector CFOs on Margin Optimization

  • Identify margin expansion opportunities through pricing structure and assumptions
  • Build scenario and sensitivity models to support informed risk‑taking
  • Improve confidence and consistency in commercial decision‑making

6. Align Commercial Models to Growth Strategy

  • Standardize and strengthen assumptions (labor productivity, inflation, mobilization)
  • Ensure pricing reinforces the Support Services value proposition
  • Help shift the organization toward performance‑ and outcome‑aligned pricing over time

Qualifications

  • 8–12+ years in commercial strategy, pricing, consulting, financial modeling, valuation, or PE‑backed environments
  • Proven experience structuring complex deal economics
  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder influence skills
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and fast‑paced RFP cycles

Plays a critical role in ensuring that patients receive high-quality care while efficiently utilizing medical resources. Reviews patient medical records, assessing the appropriateness and necessity of proposed treatments, and collaborating with healthcare providers and insurance companies to ensure a seamless care experience and the practicing of financial stewardship and denial prevention. As a Senior Developer (WMS Support), you will be responsible for providing senior-level technical support, maintenance, and continuous improvement for the organization's Warehouse Management System (WMS) platform. You will serve as an experienced technical resource responsible for production support, incident resolution, troubleshooting, system stability, performance optimization, and integration support. You will partner closely with warehouse operations, business stakeholders, IT teams and external vendors to ensure reliable and efficient warehouse operations. You will support application enhancements, upgrades, root cause analysis, and modernization initiatives while driving service quality and operational excellence across the WMS landscape.

Responsibilities:

  • Provides advanced production support for Warehouse Management System (WMS) applications, integrations, and warehouse automation platforms.
  • Manages and resolves production incidents, service requests, and support tickets within established SLAs, ensuring timely communication, thorough troubleshooting, and minimal disruption to warehouse operations.
  • Monitors application health and system performance, proactively identifying and addressing issues before they impact business operations.
  • Ensures stable and reliable operation of WMS solutions through incident management, problem management, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Works with project managers, business analysts, content specialists, and digital product owners to understand how business requirements and technical specifications will translate to actual work product across platform.
  • Writes clean, efficient and well-engineered front-end code that can serve as standard of excellence for other team members.
  • Conducts code reviews, mentors other front-end developers and provides guidance on code management, release management, environment management, process flows and documentation.
  • Explores all technical options when considering a solution, including homegrown coding, third party sub-systems, enterprise platforms and existing technology components.
  • Actively leads collaborative efforts through all phases of software development life cycle (SDLC), including requirements analysis, technical design, coding, testing, and release support.
  • Understands lifecycle of various technology sub-systems that comprise eCommerce platform (i.e., version, release, roadmap), including current capabilities, compatibilities, limitations and dependencies; understands and advises of optimal upgrade paths.
  • Leverages relationships with key IT, QA and other corporate colleagues by communicating and collaborating on cross function initiatives.
  • Develops technical documentation, such as system context diagrams, design documents and release procedures.
  • Leads troubleshooting efforts for production issues of all levels and severities, through a hands-on approach or through delegation, and assigns to third party front-end developers as appropriate and tracks progress.
  • Leads efforts to monitor web properties for uptime, and proactively identify future problems by analyzing trends, data and monitoring reporting.
  • Leads efforts to identify and develop third party vendors selection based on digital roadmap and requirements, including initial research and identification, selection, contributing to contractual discussions and operational efforts.

  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise application support, production support, or software engineering roles preferred.

  • Strong knowledge of Azure Data Factory and Databricks for data integration and analytics support preferred.
  • Proven experience troubleshooting complex application, integration, and performance issues in a production environment preferred.
  • Strong understanding of incident management, problem management, root cause analysis, and service restoration processes preferred.

  • 5 years required, 7 years preferred experience in a development role in an enterprise environment with responsibility for the delivery and support of world class technology solutions

raw.description:
Our Mission

Our mission is to SAVE AND IMPROVE LIVES BY EMPOWERING HEALTHCARE CONSUMERS. Come be part of remarkable.

Overview

How you can make a difference

At HealthEquity, we’re obsessed with protecting what matters most: our members’ health and financial wellbeing. As a Senior Third Party Risk Analyst, you’ll play a critical role in ensuring the security, resilience, and integrity of the partners and technologies powering our platform.

This is more than a compliance role. You’ll be at the intersection of cybersecurity, emerging AI risk, and operational excellence, helping evolve our Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) program to meet the pace of a fast‑moving, highly regulated environment. If you enjoy solving complex problems, improving systems through automation, and making meaningful impact at scale — this role was built for you.

What you’ll be doing

  • Conduct risk assessments for critical and operationally significant third‑party entities, including cloud service providers, SaaS platforms, technology partners, and infrastructure providers.
  • Identify, track, and drive remediation of control gaps and security risks uncovered throughout the assessment lifecycle.
  • Stay ahead of emerging risks, including generative and agentic AI, and evolving regulatory expectations across financial services and healthcare.
  • Partner closely with cross‑functional teams such as Procurement, Legal, Privacy, Security, AI Governance, and vendor business owners to manage third‑party risk holistically.
  • Develop and maintain key risk and performance metrics that demonstrate progress and maturity within the TPRM program.
  • Lead efforts to automate repetitive and high‑volume processes, leveraging advancements in AI to increase efficiency, quality, and speed.
  • Introduce and evaluate AI‑enabled tools to enhance risk clarity, improve signal‑to‑noise, and scale the program responsibly.
  • Support other TPRM and governance activities as needed, contributing to a culture of continuous improvement.

What you will need to be successful

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Risk Management, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of combined experience in information security, cybersecurity, or technical/analytical roles.
  • Experience operating in fast‑paced, high‑accountability environments where prioritization and time sensitivity matter.
  • 2–5 years of hands‑on cybersecurity experience, ideally within financial services or healthcare.
  • Strong understanding of security and AI control frameworks, such as:
    • NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF)
    • NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF)
    • ISO 42001
  • Prior experience with TPRM / GRC platforms, including tools such as Vanta, Archer, or ServiceNow.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity risk rating services (e.g., RiskRecon, SecurityScorecard, BitSight).
  • Working knowledge of audits, regulatory exams, and attestations, including SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, HITRUST, and similar frameworks.
  • Ability to review and interpret technical evidence demonstrating cybersecurity validation and compliance (e.g., SCA, SAST, DAST, penetration testing).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical and non‑technical audiences.
  • Experience reviewing technical policies and contributing to standard operating procedures.
  • Strong command of the Microsoft ecosystem, including PowerPoint, Excel, Word, SharePoint, and Power BI.
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI solutions securely and effectively, such as Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, Anthropic, or ChatGPT, to improve workflows and outcomes.
  • One or more cybersecurity certifications, such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, CRISC, or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated understanding of cybersecurity and AI governance frameworks, including NIST CSF and NIST AI RMF.

This is a remote position.

Salary Range

$87,500.00 To $111,500.00 / year

Benefits & Perks

The actual compensation offer is determined based on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, and work location. This position will be eligible for performance-based incentives as part of the total compensation package, in addition to a full range of benefits including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision
  • HSA contribution and match
  • Dependent care FSA match
  • Uncapped paid time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k) match
  • Personal and healthcare financial literacy programs
  • Ongoing education & tuition assistance
  • Gym and fitness reimbursement
  • Wellness program incentives

Onboarding & Travel

This is a remote role, with an in-person onboarding training component. New team members must participate in Trailhead, HealthEquity’s immersive onboarding experience Trailhead is designed to foster meaningful connections, support your integration into the organization, and equip you with a strong understanding of our business. Trailhead participation is a key expectation of this role. Trailhead is held onsite at our headquarters once per quarter. HealthEquity covers all required travel and accommodations.

This role may begin with a virtual, self-paced onboarding experience, followed by a mandatory onsite Trailhead session at a later date.

HealthEquity is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to team members with qualifying disabilities. Should you be selected for this role and require an accommodation, we will put you in touch with our Benefits Team so you can begin the accommodation request process.

Why work with HealthEquity

HealthEquity has a vision that by 2030 we will make HSAs as wide-spread and popular as retirement accounts. We are passionate about providing a solution that allows American families to connect health and wealth. Join us and discover a work experience where the person is valued more than the position. Click here to learn more.

You belong at HealthEquity!

HealthEquity, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to being an employer where no matter your background or identity – you feel welcome and included. We ensure equal opportunity for all applicants and employees without regard to race, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a qualified individual with a disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. HealthEquity is a drug-free workplace.
